Insight.transcription: Thank you for paying the tribute! Lord Erick will promise you more lands and wealth!

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Riding the winds and waves, Lord Erick is setting out for her great journey!
... If you need the loo, go now.

First Encounter.transcription: It's my pleasure to meet you, my fellow.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Those insane people screamed and rushed out of the guardroom.
They kept meaninglessly and repeatedly roaring. Then, their blood shed on the snowy ground.
I've seen that a lot.

To the Future.transcription:
Just like Homo sapiens wiped out Neanderthals, arcanists will be eliminated as well.
This is not a prediction, but a predestined fate.

Idle.transcription:
Where's the soap? I need to wash my hands ...
No, before that, I need to make sure the door is locked.

Greetings.transcription: Oh, it's our "genius." Any insane new ideas?

Morning.transcription: Thank you. I've already planned for my breakfast.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Too many arcanists here, weirdos as well.
Damn it ...
You'd better prepare me a room where I won't be disturbed.
Last time the girl doing the potion experiments made everywhere so dusty I could barely clean myself.

Night.transcription: Good evening. Good night.

Bond: Night.transcription:
It's very quiet out there. The door is securely locked. At night, the river whispers outside the window.
I must extend my gratitude since you prepared such a perfect room for me.
Also thanks for your suitcase. That's all, that's it.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Thanks to it, we are all freaks now.
Haven't you ever blamed your brain? Haven't you for once vomited due to the sound or whisper in your brain?
How naive and ignorant.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Compared to the incurable anxiety, these wounds are minor.
Oh, watch your distance.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Press the button, achieve the function.
Humans are like machinery, simple and efficient.
Arcanists are quite the opposite.

Hobby.transcription: What you see is the alignment and tidiness. What I adore is this orderly state.

Praise.transcription:
As an arcanist, your performance really amazes me.
Wish you were a pure blood human.

Intimacy.transcription: Could you please get your buttons right? The patterns aren't aligned.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Nearly all the arcanists I met were insane.
Only a few appeared to be normal. They just haven't lost the sanity yet.

Chitchat II.transcription:
I can only stand those arcanists from the Foundation and the Laplace.
After all, their insanity is contained by humans.

Monologue.transcription:
That's it, that's it, enough ...
Stop crying, stop, and don't laugh. Don't be insane.
I am fed up watching or hearing you. Leave me alone for a while!
Just a while! Stay away from me!

Deployment.transcription: Great, a mission with a bunch of arcanists.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Healing starts.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Relax. It's a treatment with a higher dose.

Battle Victory.transcription: Let's call it a day. I need a deep cleaning.

Insight.transcription: For the Mesmers, such achievement is effortless.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Good news: I can better ease franticity.
Bad news: I am more frantic.

First Encounter.transcription:
Hello, dear friend. From now on, we can be together all the time.
I thought of many things we can do. Firstly ...
let's roll in the grass!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
When the sun was out, I would bathe in the lake and enjoy a nap on the shore,
until my fur was warm and dry beneath the sunlight ...

To the Future.transcription:
There is a place, far away from here, and it's grander, more wonderful than all places⁠—
place where I can see the stars twinkling in the sky and snakes dancing in the grass,
as well as other things you've talked about and things I've always wanted to see. These beautiful things.

Idle.transcription:
97, 98, 99 ... 100!
I'm coming for you ...

Greetings.transcription: I'm so glad we meet again. When you were gone, I collected every hair of yours and put them in that drawer ...

Morning.transcription:
In the morning, the sun would pierce through the fog, then float across the tops of the trees and mountains ...
I bet it tastes like a raw egg ...!

Bond: Morning.transcription: Your bed feels even softer than my haystack. Can I ... crawl in and join you?

Night.transcription:
My friends are here. Do you want to meet them?
Shh ... Look! Over there behind the curtain. Can you see his feet?

Bond: Night.transcription:
Do you prefer demons or ghosts? Or the man with a chainsaw?
I have to figure out what your favorite monster is, so that I can better surprise you under your bed!

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Every time I took that "medicine," I could hear a soft, light whistling melody...
Whistling? Hmm? What is "whistling"?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: My hands in your hands, friendship never ends! You can take me to any places you go!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
This is my "ring" ... Look how snug and lovely it is!
It embraces me, securing me to my clothes and to the bed ...
Maybe we could use a ring like this to stay together.

Hobby.transcription: In that dream ... that strange dream, the grassy meadows are waiting for me, and I can hear the joyful whistle of the wind ...

Praise.transcription:
Raise your left hoof! Then your right hoof! Well done!
Now, just like in the training⁠—jump up, and roooar!

Intimacy.transcription:
When I was "Anne," I spoke as gently as possible, like this ...
Slow down, hold in the chuckles, and resist the urge to give those annoying people a good kick ...
That was difficult, but I did it!
You should say something nice to me, like those people in white do!

Chitchat I.transcription:
I saw them put a leash on that puppy. Are you going to do the same thing to me?
It's okay. I will be fine with it. As long as we are together, it doesn't matter who is on which end of the leash ...

Chitchat II.transcription:
There's a special scent on you. It ... it ... smells like honey!
Or Iris, or a crushed ladybug. I like it!

Monologue.transcription:
Why do my friends always have "more important things" to do?
We ought to cut those unwanted "shots" from our lives, keeping the takes which record our best and sweetest moments.

Deployment.transcription: Can we weigh anchor now?

Pre-Battle.transcription: Is this a new route?

Select Ultimate.transcription: It's a big party for my little boat!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: You can't separate a boat from her oars.

Battle Victory.transcription:
In the end,
we'll travel to a place with blankets of green and towering trees,
mmm ... A place I've only seen in dreams.
Like this one.

Insight.transcription: I've figured it out now! My little raft won't be spinning around any longer!

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
I'm ready⁠—ready to tell everyone my name, ready to make them scream and cry ...
Will they like me in the same way as I like them?

First Encounter.transcription:
Hi, I am Sputnik-1's ... twin sister.
No, no, no, I don't know her.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Such weather is not suitable for a rocket launch. Fortunately, I haven't planned for one today.
Ugh, another day back to work.

To the Future.transcription:
First make a small goal of increasing my deposit to a favorable amount,
and then think about where to purchase the materials.
The materials for outer shell must be carefully selected.

Idle.transcription: Even now, the continuous electric wave never ceases.

Morning.transcription: I can of course be the maid to serve you breakfast, as long as ... I am fairly paid.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
If it's alright, please take the serviette and gently wipe ...
Yeah, right here! Thank you so very much.

Night.transcription: The moon, the stars, eventually, I will be among them ...

Bond: Night.transcription:
For any satellites, night and day would have made no difference.
But for me, a night like this allows you to see me in the sky.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Bright but not too dazzling, I think orange suits me really well.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Sorry, I haven't received your signal yet. Please be patient.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
What a beautiful blue planet. It is so fascinating, so stunningly charming. I once saw it ...
I mean I once saw the picture of such scenery from "elsewhere."

Hobby.transcription:
I need more money, more money!
I might sound shallow and greedy, but it will enable us, all of us,
to be in a better place.

Praise.transcription:
You shine luminously and gloriously, it is even visible from space.
You have my word.

Intimacy.transcription:
In the very, very, very distant future, I will leave this place.
I swear I will miss you. Please remember me.

Chitchat I.transcription:
How about Explorer-3?
Oh, I have to say he looked brilliant.
But compared to Phobos-1, he's just like an ... immature little boy.

Chitchat II.transcription:
DUU-DUU-BELL-BOO from the other side of the atmosphere,
is so special and unique that I almost know nothing about it. What a negligence!

Monologue.transcription:
Oh, alright, it's nothing miraculous. The birth of new life comes unexpectedly.
I just suddenly learnt how to hear, speak and think.
Therefore, I was derailed from the scheduled track and started to embrace my "life."

Deployment.transcription: A nice job.

Pre-Battle.transcription: According to the NDA, we must wipe out all witnesses.

Select Ultimate.transcription: Final check complete. Start the countdown.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Three, two, one, launch!

Battle Victory.transcription: It's over. Hopefully the victory won't make me more recognizable.

Insight.transcription: My travel fund is growing steadily. Thank you very much for your support.

First Encounter.transcription:
Congratulations. You are about to unveil the truth of this world.
Welcome to Headonion, a show to reshape your conception.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Last time it rained like this, we spotted an unidentified flying object commit the theft of a cow.
We are now still tracing any possible signs left by it.
Our show, Headonion would like to remind all our farm owners. Please watch out for the thief from above.
Do not leave your cows, cats, and shepherd dogs unattended!

To the Future.transcription:
The future? It's gloomy.
A running mansion, artificial aurora, mass-manufactured circuit men ...
Ahhh, the world is doomed to drown in chaos.

Idle.transcription:
Now to our news exclusive!
This nothing-special suitcase here,
stores a sumptuous apartment with all the necessary home appliances.
It will soon become the trend of future accommodation, but also the nightmare for all real estate developers.
Please follow me, let's enjoy the room tour to the attic.

Greetings.transcription:
Please welcome our mysterious guest ...
Oops, my bad. Just an occupational habit.

Morning.transcription:
Such a bright morning.
Today, somewhere over there, the mysterious and indescribable incidents are still in occurrence.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
People have been fed up with those boring news headlines.
Or, are they just satisfied with the world they are living in?

Night.transcription:
It's late, but I am about to prepare for tomorrow's broadcast.
I won't go to bed, nor will I take off my headgear.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Headonion will present you the latest news for tonight.
The US Congress plans to impose restrictions on TV exercise programs outside working hours,
due to the recent sightings of the Capitol going hiking at midnight.
It is estimated that the mansion will arrive in Memphis, Tennessee in no time.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
This is not a made up newspaper, but an onion headgear as my disguise.
The denotation is to delve into mystery one layer at a time to eventually find the truth.
For your information, it is not waterproof so please be cautious.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
I have touched that glittering skyscraper.
Exactly the same as I reported.
It was covered in scales and a stinky smell of marine algae emanated from it.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
A charming gentleman in a suit, this is how I present myself in my show.
Just like this crazy world, what people see ...
is only the products created and refined by those behind the scenes.

Hobby.transcription:
Who said I love eating onion? Was he insane?!
ONiON is my pen name, a pen name! It's just a name!
Damn I hate onion, ewwwww!

Praise.transcription:
You've offered me something precious: trust and understanding.
That's what I really need now.

Intimacy.transcription:
My onion headgear is easily worn out so I will prepare several more.
Come on, let me show you how to make one.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Apart from being sharp, you also must be fast,
to run ahead of the unexpected and to escape the dangers.

Chitchat II.transcription:
New treatment to patients suffering from blood circuitization has been found.
It is now been put on the hospital's agenda to seek cooperation with power plants,
"Aurora may be the work of some graffiti extremists,
as some members of the sperm whale family alleged they had found the aerosol cans for special paints" ...
All these are strictly prohibited by our station manager but someday I will definitely ...

Monologue.transcription:
To accept only the "truth" is to miss the truth.
Sadly, few people understand this.

Deployment.transcription: I am in. I have seen so many precious materials.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hey, you crazy world!

Select Incantation I.transcription: Let's get straight to the point!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Ladies and gentlemen, please be ready, to witness the real world!

Battle Victory.transcription: What takes place in our real world, is far more absurd than what you see on my show.

Insight.transcription:
Peel off one layer of the onion, inside it's still onion.
Put on your glasses, watch out for the pain in your eyes and the burst of tears!

First Encounter.transcription:
Oh, welcome to my embroidery house. What brings you here?
The design that's all the rage in the city, the legendary cloth said to withstand fire, or ... a tale woven with intrigue and passion?

Suitcase Climate.transcription: When you spend every day spinning thread from ice silkworms like I do, even snow no longer feels cold.

To the Future.transcription:
If, one day, there's no more blood to spill and no more feuds to bury,
perhaps I'll finally become an ordinary embroiderer—or a surgeon.
Any role where my needle and thread truly belong.

Idle.transcription: Silk threads ... peacock feathers ... oh, and this peculiar material too—freshly cut hair.

Greetings.transcription: Here we go gathering mulberry leaves, filled with treasures the silkworms weave.

Morning.transcription: The silkworms only like dry leaves—no morning dew allowed. Quite the picky eaters, aren't they?

Bond: Morning.transcription: Care to join me outside? I have silk to dry, and the morning light is just right.

Night.transcription: Some memories are best left hidden in the dense stitches and the dim light.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Butterflies fluttering from the silk? You must be imagining things.
You'd better get an early night tonight.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Oh, be careful—the needles might prick you.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: My embroidery style features a dozen stitch techniques ... Would you like me to try them on you?

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Acupoints, meridians, veins—they're linked like threads of silk. I see them all, clear as crystal.

Hobby.transcription: Good, good. Only silk pulsing with life can be spun into vigorous thread.

Praise.transcription:
Your Suitcase may be limited in space, but its peace and tranquility more than make up for it.
Perhaps, here, I can escape worldly turmoil and truly find a sense of home ...

Intimacy.transcription:
Thousands of silkworms gave their lives, and an embroiderer cut off her own hair—all to create this exceptional thread work.
So, what would you trade for it?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Relax, running stitch is easy. Just hold the needle steady and make sure each stitch is even, neat, and—ah, just a prick;
let me patch you up. Not to worry, with a little practice, your fingers will be safe.

Chitchat II.transcription: Many bend over backwards for a life of silk and satin, never realizing that they are just the silkworm.

Monologue.transcription:
I've met many who lived on a blade's edge who feared this tiny needle and thread.
But there's no need for you to be afraid—now they're only used to create ... *chuckle* beautiful patterns.

Deployment.transcription: The life of blood and steel is long behind me, but for you, I'm willing to make an exception.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Fortunately, my needle hasn't dulled a bit.

Select Ultimate.transcription: Girls, let's give our guests a proper welcome.

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: There's a needle beneath this silk.

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: A brocade yet to be finished.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Like the rosy sheen of silk newly dyed; shine on, shine on.

Battle Victory.transcription: One moment; I'm just finishing up this embroidery.

Insight.transcription: Only through struggle may one reach true mastery ... much like the ice silkworm in metamorphosis.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
I have mastered my stitching techniques.
Anything corporeal yields to my needle—be it an antique fan, an exquisite brocade ...
or an enemy's heart.

Enter.transcription: Sorry to have kept you waiting. As you can see, I just finished dealing with some unwanted pests.

voicelines.transcription: Hmm ... Perhaps you're right—what we're used to often seems best.

First Encounter.transcription:
Oh, it's very nice to meet you.
This room is very classy,
yet it can use a bit of warmth to its perfection.
I think I can offer you a solution.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
The Cactus Cat will enjoy a sunny day like this.
On the contrary, Carbuncles prefer cloudy weather.

To the Future.transcription:
Future, what an intriguing topic.
It's about new things being born and old things dying.
I'm curious about everything in the future, and I will take my shot.

Idle.transcription:
Instead of words, I'm always expecting eye contact.
It feels good even if we don't say a word, doesn't it?

Greetings.transcription: No matter business or bonding, you're always welcome.

Morning.transcription:
Starting my morning with a warm cup of black tea.
This is one of the few habits I have from my family.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
I'm preparing breakfast for these little things. Could you please give me a hand?
Thank you very much.

Night.transcription: Good evening, dear. Glad to see that everything is going well with you.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Dear, are you worried about some uninvited guests disturbing the suitcase?
Loretta, Dwayne, guard the door.
We'll have a great evening. I promise.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Looking tidy is an important step in building trust.
Before selling something, we always have to sell ourselves.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Don't waste your strength in wrestling with the critters.
The leash in your hand is not for curbing them, but understanding them.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Heh heh, clothes make the woman, don't they?

Hobby.transcription:
Gentle, loyal, and kind ...
They are more than my career, they are a part of my life.

Praise.transcription:
Good girl ...
Oh, I'm so sorry. Habits are hard to break.

Intimacy.transcription:
Imagine, the news of Miss Vertin's Appearance at the NewBabel Pet Tour.
How will this surprise the eagle-eyed journalists and indecisive families?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Squonks are the most difficult to catch, tame, and keep.
These shy and timid little creatures will turn into a cloud of tears if they are just slightly spooked.
But they are good companions to the traumatized and quiet children, for they understand each other.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Stress stress stress ...
Teakettler needs more anecdotal stories to get people's attention.

Monologue.transcription:
I haven't doubted my success in the future for even a second.
NewBabel will change the world.

Deployment.transcription: Excuse me ... Sorry, a bit crowded here.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Play time, boys and girls.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: These glowing lights ... We are the master and maven of the place.

Battle Victory.transcription: Your firsthand experience is our best advertisement.

Insight.transcription:
I have laid my hands on the souls of critters. They're soft and hard,
like the dew in the desert in the early morning, like the tide in the ocean at night.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
NewBabel will be popular in each and every household.
We set our feet on today, eyes on tomorrow.

First Encounter.transcription:
Hm? Do you have anything to tell me, young lady?
No, not those cliched greetings.
It should be a tender one, with some heartwarming words ...
How do you greet your mother?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
When reaching my age, most people are just like the thick cloud in the sky,
burdened with cumulative agony and joy ...
Their countenance also demonstrates the story of ageing, which is quite hard to ease.

To the Future.transcription:
There will be a day when I defeat those "geniuses" at lawn bowls.
I just need some more practice, or ... a little more patience.

Idle.transcription: Hey, my child. Do you have a television here? I'd fancy taking a nap with my blanket on the sofa ...

Greetings.transcription: It's always good to have you here no matter if you found a bargain or suffered a loss.

Morning.transcription:
Young people are all the same. They don't cherish the day ...
Don't look at me like that. I'm speaking from experience.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Quit yawning, sleepyhead. Let's play lawn bowls together!
All you need to do is hold this umbrella ... and count my scores.

Night.transcription:
The night offers a chance for all stories—bloodshed, adoration, impulsion ...
The world we live in is ever-changing, that's why I love watching The Night Show.
The content is invariable and warmed-over; the view is indifferent,
and the best part is, it's never late.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Fall asleep by a warm fireplace ...
That was the only way I spent my night for a long time.
Well, now we have proms, and sofas, and the 29 inch CRT TVs.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
To gain a foothold in these times is no bed of roses. A pretty face is indeed the icing on the cake,
but what really matters is a good mind and a clear view of the time.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Go on, try holding it, and feel its temperature rising in your hand ...
Easy, sweetheart ... take it easy, heh heh ...

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Body, the enemy of the ripe old age, the friend of the flower of youth.

Hobby.transcription:
The marine animals are a gift from mother nature. Their meat is fresh, the texture is soft,
and their blood is sweet with the unique ...
Oh, I'm terribly sorry. It seems it's not a pleasant topic for you.

Praise.transcription:
You are such a brilliant young lady. Would you mind being my apprentice?
Well, before that I need to ask you one question—are you allergic to seafood?

Intimacy.transcription: No need to propose a toast. Let's just call it a day and go home to watch a vampire movie in bed ...

Chitchat I.transcription:
My immortality allows me to be well-informed. No matter the dead or alive,
you can have your answer from me as long as the pay is adequate.
But ... just like anyone with a clear mind won't touch a hot potato, I suggest you keep your little nose clean.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Your Foundation is really a pain in the neck, my child.
They had a grudge against me because of the special invisibility cloak and the feud still continues today.
But in my defense, they had a 7-day warranty. What else do they want?
Or, they can just ... give it a try and buy one more.

Monologue.transcription:
In Exeter, Death only spared me.
I often feel like a scarecrow. Everything around me keeps changing, growing, and eventually comes to an end.
But I remain unchanged and alone.

Deployment.transcription: Alright, just one thing: I will be home by 10 p.m.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Anyone offer your seat to the senior?

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: Would you buy me a drink?

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: Hmm ... A little bit hot here.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: The ocean dried, and I'm alone again ...

Battle Victory.transcription: Pride goes before the fall. I've been there. You'd better take it.

Insight.transcription: Well ... just a tiny piece of change in my long calm life.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
This is my secret of keeping young ... Fresh milk before bed.
Hmm ... The thick scent of milk.

First Encounter.transcription:
Alright, ready to welcome me!
Prepare your softest brush, smoothest silk, flaxseed oil or something more expensive, and ...
Hey, is that a carrot? Ohh! For me? Thank you!

Suitcase Climate.transcription: Darley Clatter is ready, is ready, is ready!

To the Future.transcription:
Run, chase liberty.
Now I am racing on the ground. In the future, I will be dashing in the sky!

Idle.transcription: Ho, ho ho! From now on, this is the racecourse of Darley Clatter!

Greetings.transcription: You are granted an audience with the Darley Arabian.

Morning.transcription: Let the morning sunlight shine on my mane. It deserves that ... I mean the sunlight.

Bond: Morning.transcription: Darley sometimes gets up late. There's nothing to be blamed.

Night.transcription:
Please offer me a bed with a soft mattress,
goose down duvet, rabbit fur cover, delicate sewing patterns and designer perfume sprayed.

Bond: Night.transcription:
That is awesome! You must really be looking forward to spending a wonderful evening with Darley!
Oh the story, about the golden carrot in the lake, you have my permission to tell it one more time.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Oh ...
I can't deny you are really good at patting.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Faster than the wind! I am undoubtedly the fastest runner!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Take a look at my beautiful muscles! I don't need to explain how fabulous I am.
Hey, watch out! Rub me in the direction my mane grows.

Hobby.transcription:
The breeze that combs my mane, the golden carrot, and my little Lilian ...
Oh, you don't know her? She is my lady ... Ahem, my maid!

Praise.transcription: Oh yes! The great Lord of the Wooden Rocking Horse, is me, who grants you the right to ride on my back!

Intimacy.transcription:
Adorable?
Ahh? You don't even have a taste!

Chitchat I.transcription:
Mass production? Oh my god!
The great ... great Darley Arabian is the one and only!!

Chitchat II.transcription:
Hey, hey! Come over here. I have a secret to share. I am the legendary Darley Arabian ...
Why are you laughing? Come on this is not funny at all!

Monologue.transcription:
All the horses shall race freely,
no matter made of wood or iron, glass or flesh and blood.
As long as they possess the soul of a real horse, they are qualified to race.

Deployment.transcription: Enter the starting gate!

Pre-Battle.transcription: Race, race, race!

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: Right, that's exactly what I live for.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: The endowments from the great Arabian!

Battle Victory.transcription:
Hey, anyone there?
I need to get my hoofs ... Oops, I mean wheels cleaned.

Insight.transcription: Darley Arabian does not need a clean body. The mud is the glory!

First Encounter.transcription: Ms., your hat is tilted.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Lighting needs to be appropriate. Too bright will cause overexposure ...
And the films should be saved for sensational moments.

To the Future.transcription:
The smoke of war has never fully cleared. It just occasionally gets thinner ...
I will follow it and keep photographing it until the day it eventually dissipates.

Idle.transcription:
I am no longer afraid of land mines ...
Wait, I never was.

Greetings.transcription: If possible ... a knock on the door will be appreciated.

Morning.transcription:
I am not afraid of the sun. I just dislike being exposed to it ...
Maybe I need a pair of sunglasses?

Bond: Morning.transcription:
If you are interested, I can show you my "workplace."
Hmm ... remember to take your safety helmet.

Night.transcription:
Those air raids always strike at night,
so it is probably a good thing to stay awake late at night ...
no matter as a civilian or a war correspondent.

Bond: Night.transcription:
There's no day and night in the air-raid shelter ... but it's not depressing.
Sometimes, not frequently, people enjoy the afternoon tea in the dark ...
so do I. Taking photos of them sometimes makes me feel much better.

Hat and Hair.transcription: I once had a strong helmet. And then ... then what happened ...?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Baseline 100mm, shutter speed 1/1250 of a second; it's very resilient ...
This camera is the best device to take with me to cross the ruins and record the truth.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
I am visible but impalpable ...
This is ideal for a journalist.

Hobby.transcription: Or ... sometimes, I have nothing to do but float ...

Praise.transcription:
The Great Adventure of Ms. Vertin
, another memorable photo portfolio.

Intimacy.transcription: Do you ... mind me putting these photos of you into my portfolio?

Chitchat I.transcription:
A quarrel is happening in the hall 320 meters away.
It's the wolf and ... the lily. Sorry, I have to go.

Chitchat II.transcription:
This one is much funnier. A white kitten is confronting a lady ...
It seems not into vegetables because cats just aren't.

Monologue.transcription:
Is war correspondent a good occupation?
... It shaped me into somebody but also took my life away.
Now I can still take photos, so I think death is not a bad ending.

Deployment.transcription: Standing by you ... like an ally?

Pre-Battle.transcription: Join the battlefield, like what I've always been doing.

Select Incantation II.transcription: One sec, need a better angle.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: A historic moment for commemoration.

Battle Victory.transcription:
I used too many films ...
but it is worthwhile.

Insight.transcription:
This portfolio ... you wanna buy it?
... It is my honor!

Bottom of Insight.transcription: ... A perfect moment!

First Encounter.transcription: Heh heh ...

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Forte ...
piano.

To the Future.transcription:
Hmm?
... Hmm.

Idle.transcription: *a soothing piece*

Greetings.transcription:
*humming*
*surprised*
... Heh heh.

Morning.transcription: Hm?

Bond: Morning.transcription: Um ...

Night.transcription: Shh.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Hmm.
*a dreamy piece*

Hat and Hair.transcription: Oh?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Hm...

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Hee hee.

Hobby.transcription:
Woof ...
"Meow" ...
"Coo coo" ...

Praise.transcription: *a cheerful piece*

Intimacy.transcription: *humming*

Chitchat I.transcription: Hm ...

Chitchat II.transcription: Heh heh.

Monologue.transcription:
I ... can't over exaggerate my gratitude for that planetary alignment.
It ... brought me that letter.

Deployment.transcription: *a piece of music symbolizing her trying*

Pre-Battle.transcription: *a set of lively notes*

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Stars.

Battle Victory.transcription:
Phew ...
Yes, great.

Insight.transcription: *a piece soaked in moonlight*

Bottom of Insight.transcription: It's a secret.

First Encounter.transcription: New friends ... new friends ... new investor ... new friends!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Outing canceled?! I'm just getting excited!
Damn ... Not even a decent enclosed training field here?!

To the Future.transcription:
I have to say thank you to the "Storm."
Without it, those old fogies would have never given me the green light for research and so much funding.

Idle.transcription:
Oh ... No one else's here?
Great. I own the place now.

Greetings.transcription:
Hmm, hmm ...?
Oh, I just ... passed out.
Nice to see you here. Take the notebook on the desk and write down what I say ...

Morning.transcription: The bread is mine now. Make yourself another one.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Here, take the latest Arcane Biology Daily.
Now see how they praise me and learn carefully.

Night.transcription:
Next, I'll sing a song here.
My dear friends, say goodbye to your sleep.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Just you and I?
Great! Leave me alone and I will, too. Let's sit across each other until dawn!
That's the best companionship.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
This? Not bad. It's tough to bite and ...
This is your hat?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Don't restrict yourself to the suggested amount. An effective trail needs bold attempts.
So, I will say: full dose!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Hiss ... Hah ...
After ten minutes ... the mid clavicle ... the fourth rib, remittent ... pain ...

Hobby.transcription:
You should take a look at the field Laplace prepared for me.
More than one hundred and twenty square meters.
Plenty of balls, frisbees, ladders, sandbags, sponge dummies.
Of course, it's open space.

Praise.transcription:
Hah, much more comfortable in the suitcase. Flexible time for research, independent laboratory ...
and unlimited freedom.

Intimacy.transcription: The experiments I do here ... Keep them a secret from Laplace. I'll make you an offer.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Family ...? Oh! Parents! If you had said this earlier, I would have understood.
I just don't have any reproductive organs. It's not like I'm born from stone.
Of course I have a family, a mother and a father.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Seriously, how obsessive are you guys ... The pronoun thing, I don't give a damn.
She, he, they, whatever you like ...
Hmm ... Well, if you had to choose, rofecoxib and pregabalin, which do you prefer?

Monologue.transcription:
Humans are so busy distinguishing themselves from animals,
busy being arrogant, calling themselves "creator's favorite and miracles" ...
Hilarious. They think they're so exceptional, yet so much mediocrity in front of me.

Deployment.transcription: Me? Is everyone else dead?

Pre-Battle.transcription: Let's kill time together.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Go, go! Go for it! Puppies!

Battle Victory.transcription: Huh? It's already over?

Insight.transcription: Thank you very much. How about increasing the research funding by tw- ... fifty percent?

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Don't run, puppy. I'll catch you in a minute ...

First Encounter.transcription:
Aaaah!
Sorry, I'm so sorry ...

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Sunshine?!
I gotta stay away ... before the rashes get on me again.

To the Future.transcription:
Emm ... I'm just a ghost, dead, no future ahead. I hope you can understand.
Oh, I'm not judging your idea. They are very lovely thoughts ... perfect thoughts.

Idle.transcription:
No ... don't! Where did you go?
Oh my god ... Where are you? Don't leave me alone! Please ...

Greetings.transcription: Welcome to my place. We can ... play together here.

Morning.transcription:
I've made you breakfast, but it's all ruined by the seawater dripping off my sheets.
This is just like the party I went to, so ruined ... Haha ...

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Hi, what did you dream about last night?
You were mumbling in your dream.
I could barely hear anything even though I have moved very very close to you.

Night.transcription:
Listen! Did you hear that? The ticking sound of a clock.
This ... this is too quiet, nobody noticed me, nobody looked over, I ... I ...

Bond: Night.transcription:
Can you stay? Can we talk, just ... just for a while. Please look at me.
But ... not for too long.
You can watch me for 3.5 seconds, and look away for ... for 5 seconds. Then look back at me again.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
It's always so wet, sometimes itchy ...
What is this?!

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Well ... I ... This is my finger, Ms. ...

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Are you saying ... people only have two legs?
Ooh! But how did I get this leg?
No. Wait! I'm trying to recall ...

Hobby.transcription:
Sometimes I would watch TV, those drama series were so great.
And mom would bring me apple pie and soda.
Um ... I really miss times like that.

Praise.transcription: You're totally far out! Even beat the most popular girls.

Intimacy.transcription: I like new sheets, or as long as it is cleaned. But don't take them off me, please.

Chitchat I.transcription:
I think I dig it ... I must have picked up an extra leg from the sea ...
but I don't remember which one is mine, not to mention that I have picked up more than one leg ...

Chitchat II.transcription:
I looked up in the water, watching the last breath of oxygen flee in bubbles,
then I heard ringing in my ears ...

Monologue.transcription:
I'm not pretty enough. I have thick legs and freckles.
I'm not even close to being as pretty as those people on TV or as popular as other students.
I like my bedsheet. It's great. It protects me.
I will come out of my sheets when I'm less afraid,
in near future ... theoretically ...

Deployment.transcription: Woo ...

Pre-Battle.transcription: This is gonna be a haunted house.

Cast Ultimate.transcription:
Please look over here ...
Ooh! No no no!

Battle Victory.transcription:
Perfect ... They have noticed me,
and ... and didn't stare for awkwardly long. I enjoyed this ...

Insight.transcription:
Are you being sarcastic?
No?

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
What do you think of my beachwear? Does it look bad?
Yes ... yes?

First Encounter.transcription: Hmmm ... Excuse me, is this the way to the audition?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Raindrops and dance, singing under the streetlamp—
Ah, that one classic dance in the rain.
If someday I could be starring ...

To the Future.transcription:
A character for me, a line for me,
such a day will eventually come to me.

Idle.transcription:
Hello, I am Bette. I am here for the new character audition. I am going to present you ...
No no no ...
Hello, my name is Bette. I am here for the audition!

Greetings.transcription:
Hello, please take a seat.
Oh I'm sorry. Just a minute, I'll find another place for these costumes right now!

Morning.transcription:
Oh, bacon, a big no no for all beautiful girls on the film crew.
They envy my ability to change appearance, but I am so jealous of their lines.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning, how do I look? Do you think I can nail today's audition?
It's for an ordinary character and the only line is "Good morning".
But ... it's still better than nothing!

Night.transcription:
Oh hello ... I didn't realize you're here.
This, this is just a notebook. Nothing special. It's just my script ...

Bond: Night.transcription:
Vagrants, forty-niners, hairdressers, winos ...
every one of us lives a life and every night we share the sky.
This is what films teach us. Magical, isn't it?

Hat and Hair.transcription: Cover my hair, blur my features! Now it's all up to my acting.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Ha ha ... They might be a little rough.
To tightly grab the eave does require abundant practice.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Before the advent of sound in films, body language was the only way to express emotions.
See, like this!

Hobby.transcription:
When I am upset, frustrated or fail the audition,
I always stay in my bedroom going through my little notebook.
The rustling sound of paper always helps calm me down.

Praise.transcription:
Well done, perfect! Let's call it a day!
Oh, sorry, I forgot we are not filming.

Intimacy.transcription:
Argh, don't mind me ... I'm just observing, or imitating you.
Just in case someday you might need a reliable stand-in.

Chitchat I.transcription: Never give up, the future is bright. Everything's gonna be alright!

Chitchat II.transcription:
A 720° flip and a 3½ backward somersault ...
Uhh, I ... I am not sure ... Are these heroics really necessary?

Monologue.transcription:
I've dreamt forever about my first character,
not as a rich young man, a courageous adventurer, a fair or rich lady,
but the first character starred by me, Bette with brown hair!
I have noted them all in this notebook, which is called "My Script."

Deployment.transcription: Here I am!

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hah, director, I am ready!

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: And a forward roll? No problem!

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: It's my duty to reduce damage!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Salute to you, my lord!

Battle Victory.transcription: Have I made it, director?

Insight.transcription: What? I am so very grateful for your approval!

First Encounter.transcription:
Hello, Ms. Timekeeper. We're a team now.
If you encounter any difficulties with your assignment or the study of arcanum,
please feel free to ask me any questions, just as Ms. Sotheby does.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
At that time, I failed to make it to Ms. Sotheby's side because of a mission,
leaving her alone in the face of that cruel ... "Storm."
But you were there for her, Timekeeper ... Please allow me to express my gratitude again.

To the Future.transcription:
Teaching is ... more suitable for me than my current job.
Some say only the unambitious people who seek an easy life would choose to be a private tutor,
and I'm not even professionally qualified for teaching.
But I ... I really hope my time as a teacher would never come to an end.

Idle.transcription: Let me ... check when my next class starts ...

Greetings.transcription: Hello, chi le ma nin?

Morning.transcription:
At this time of the day, the porcelain factory in my hometown has started the morning shifts.
Heh-heh, I wonder how it is doing now.
Feels like I was there yesterday.

Bond: Morning.transcription: Timeke ... Ha ha, you seem sleepy. Do you need another nap?

Night.transcription:
Mr. APPLe is a wonderful teacher.
Compared to him, I'm neither experienced nor knowledgeable enough.
Perhaps I should seek some advice from him tonight in terms of home education.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Butter cookies, sweet and crumbly, are always popular among the kids.
Do you want some?
But don't forget to brush you teeth. I will come and check later.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
A gentle stroke on the student's head or at their backs can encourage them to express themselves,
and it will become a healthy start of a positive teacher-student relationship.
Encouragement and recognition are always more helpful in raising a happy and confident child rather than harsh criticisms.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
I've done something terrible with these hands,
and something good.
The past is a part of who I am, and I must accept it.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Although the Foundation is well-known for their effective ways of teaching,
they always overlooked each student's character and personality.
Hmm ... I find their teaching philosophy difficult to comment on.

Hobby.transcription:
When I lived in DC, I learnt to play an old boardgame from the East.
It's quite simple.
Are you interested as well?

Praise.transcription: You are competent for many jobs, whether for the Foundation or for yourself.

Intimacy.transcription:
Timekeeper ... thank you for taking care of Ms. Sotheby.
I'm least worried when she's with you.
Ahem, could you ... could you please also review Ms. Sotheby's potion assignment for me next week?
Well ... there will be an exhibition of eastern cultures in town.

Chitchat I.transcription:
The blue and white porcelain animal chasing ball plate of Bevington ...
What a delicate piece of work, wish I could see it with my own eyes.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Standing on a flying sword!
Wow, looks so much more graceful than riding on a broomstick.
The Chinese arcanum is utterly brilliant!

Monologue.transcription:
As the Chinese saying goes, "Sai Weng Shi Ma, Yan Zhi Fei Fu."
I think my life cannot be better described.

Deployment.transcription: Practice is the best teacher.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Take a lesson from Ms. "Moisson."

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Like harvesting on the wheatfield.

Battle Victory.transcription: Class over. Don't forget your homework.

Insight.transcription: More books read, more strength gained.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
This dress reminds me of my hometown,
and those beautiful, fragile porcelains.
It's hard to imagine what a dangerous weapon they would make once broken.

First Encounter.transcription:
Greetings to you, fair lady, may I present you a rose?
Oh, seems like you won't fall for this cheap flattery. I'm ashamed.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Sunlight eases people's mind and endows diamonds with glowing luxury.
What a perfect occasion for deceiving.

To the Future.transcription:
So what's next?
The young lady of the rich, resolute and courageous as she is,
disregards my humble beginnings and takes her possessions to elope with me.
But then, I will leave her and disappear, forever.

Idle.transcription:
A cigar would make a nifty accessory,
and those gracious ladies would certainly love to see their lover to be a sight for the eyes.
But ... no, thank you. I'd prefer my teeth unstained.

Greetings.transcription:
Good day, my lord.
You're too kind visiting me, and I regret to receive you in a room of nothing.

Morning.transcription:
Another beautiful morning arrives, and many beautiful things are about to come.
I see people opening their arms, waiting to go to the ball, new clothes, new flatteries,
and new glittering stars to come to them.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning, my lady.
I've prepared you fresh coffee, sandwiches, and this shiny diamond.
Of course, I would never lie to you, this is a piece of cultured work.
But look how it sparkles, how elegant, isn't it?

Night.transcription:
Would I have the honor to invite you for dinner?
There's a banquet held by someone I don't know.
Huh? A freeloader?
No no no, I'd say it would be lavish of us if we don't enjoy it.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Ruby Port, a beauty from Douro Valley.
Em ... tastes as sweet as it smells.
Believe me, it will make your evening unforgettable.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
A decent gentleman will not let go of this.
But be careful, don't let it tilt to your eyes.
Eye contact is vital.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Although I'm not woman of guns, it's necessary to carry one.
I'm sure you know the reason why.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
I don't dislike dresses.
They are pretty, delicately embroidered, intricately sewed apparels.
They are what I'm supposed to wear, not these trousers.
Heh, destiny holds a different plan, doesn't it?

Hobby.transcription:
Diddling, rightly considered, is a compound of which the ingredients are
minuteness, interests, perseverance, ingenuity,
audacity, nonchalance, originality, impertinence, and grin.

Praise.transcription:
You have every virtue that belongs to a deceiver, yet you're a woman of honesty.
I don't know if I should admire your righteous nature, or lament the waste of gifts.

Intimacy.transcription:
If you want to, you're always welcome at my place.
I will be here, with my cleverest scam, waiting for your arrival and, of course, an invitation to yours.

Chitchat I.transcription:
If my eyes serve me well,
it's the "Bay of Light" this respectable young lady is wearing.
Oh, don't worry, I won't do anything.
She is of a background too prominent and an age too young for my tricks.

Chitchat II.transcription:
New Delhi? To be honest, I barely remember anything about it.
It doesn't make much difference to England, aside from the scorching sun.

Monologue.transcription:
We are two of a kind, dear.
We would employ every means possible to find out the truth we crave to know.
We are very alike.

Deployment.transcription:
A crime group?
Heh, just to my likings.

Pre-Battle.transcription: I don't like to resort to violence, but accidents happen.

Select Incantation I.transcription: Glad to be of service, my lady.

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: A design of its own kind.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Fragrance and dazzle can easily confuse one's vision. I'm sorry for you.

Battle Victory.transcription:
Now, to divide the spoils ...
Or should I say, a reasonable reallocation of the profits?

Insight.transcription: To its perfection, to its best clarity.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Shush, my lady, let us enjoy this moment,
this beautiful, short, enchanted moment.

Knock first!

Matilda is of course the best.

Si douce, si délicate comme un doux rêve ... ses mains sont comme de la barbe à papa ...

Jusqu'à, jusqu'à ...

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Rock paper scissors!
Rock paper scissors!
I win!

Clothing and Torso.transcription: I get taller now!

This little thing is for you.
It can move and make noises.
Squeak! Kiki! Hahahaha!

Intimacy.transcription:
How can people just show up whenever I want to play?

Chitchat I.transcription: All work, no play, makes Jack a dull boy.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Dave used to be bad!

Now, he is our best friend!

Monologue.transcription:
I don't want to be alone.
Luckily I'm never alone.

Deployment.transcription: I wanna go, I wanna go too!

Pre-Battle.transcription: New friends.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Now you have a friend to play with you too!

To the Future.transcription: More needs, more opportunities! More ghost, more possibilities!

Idle.transcription: Let me catch up some sleep ... Just a nap ...

Greetings.transcription: Oh! Welcome, Sir Vertin!

Morning.transcription:
Hm ... Last night? I didn't go out last night, busy writing my blog.
And then, boom! Morning!
Sleep? Maybe in my next life ...

Bond: Morning.transcription: Huh? Morning ... Now leave me, I'm still sleepy ...

Night.transcription: I've got you some very horrible movies, and I promise you it's gonna be an unforgettable evening!

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Whoa! Be careful, people has 3 fire of life!
Ah, you don't say that here?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: What? You want a palm reading?

The yellow Taoist robe is so long, so soft and so trouble. Most importantly, it doesn't match my skin color!
If there is no fashion clothes, who will trust my "Neo-Science Exorcism Office" ?

After a ghost's reincarnation, I can get its energy.
Just need to transform them, boil water, roast meat, make batteries, nothing is a problem.
Especially the meat! I'll say it's No. 1 in the world!

Praise.transcription:
Hm ... Have you considered to learn some skills?
For example, ghost hunting?
First you need to pass the Russian Courage training.

Intimacy.transcription:
Seriously, you don't let me get close to the transparent reporter?
Not even the drenched girl?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Chocolates are both a kind of snack and an anti-ghost weapon.
Plastic wrap can catch the ghost while wrapping my leftovers.
A real bargain!

Chitchat II.transcription:
The Yin-yang 3D glasses,
you need to soak it in willow leaf water and a cow's tear, then rub it,
put it under the moonlight of when the Yin-qi volume reaches its maximum for 49 days.
If you want to make it, you can check my blog. It's a beginner's guide, but I can't guarantee you can learn it.

Monologue.transcription:
Ghost is not as complicated as you think. It's an ... energy force that couldn't be seen or touched.
Even if it stands in front of you or actually tries to hurt you, it is just a hallucination.
It is an effect formed by your visual nerves caused by that certain energy force ...
Anyway, say goodbye to the stereotypes and there is nothing horrible.

Deployment.transcription: Neo-Science Exorcism Office, action!

Pre-Battle.transcription: Oh! Go back to work!

Cast Ultimate.transcription:
So spooky, so gloomy, toplight turning dim and bright, that is ...
so scary! Haha!

Battle Victory.transcription: It's now I catch you, not you catch me!

Insight.transcription: Nice! I like it.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Ha! I got you!
You can do anything but you choose to hurt people.
Go listen to Lily's lesson and study again, reincarnate soon!

First Encounter.transcription:
はじめまして。どうぞよろしくお願いします。
Ms. ... Timekeeper, is it?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
「雷神の少し響みてさし曇り雨もふらぬか君を留めむ」
「雷神の少し響みてふらずとも吾は留らむ妹し留めば」
The customers in the cafe taught me this.

I would like to be with the boss and children ...
Now, and in the future.

どなたかいらっしゃいませんか？
... It's so quiet ... How is everyone in the cafe now?

Two gentlemen walked into a fine brick building ...
Oh, Ms. Timekeeper! My sincerest apologies. I was immersed in a novel and did not notice you ...

Morning.transcription: Good morning. Would you like some tea or coffee today?

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning, breakfast is ready. There is miso soup, rice ...
Are you not used to having rice for breakfast?

Night.transcription: It's late. Are you still working?

Bond: Night.transcription:
When I was in jail,
the guard in the jail would tell me about the fun parts of his day once night fell ...
I wonder how he is doing now.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
私、お洒落はからっきし…　でしたが、
女将さんのご指導で少しだけ馴染むようになりました。

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: For my survival, I did some thing that resulted in me getting this ... accessory.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Please don't ...
Ah, you didn't mean to?

Hobby.transcription:
Hobby? I have never thought about it,
because the only thing need to be worried about is the immediate future ...

Praise.transcription:
すごいです ... There must be nothing you cannot do.
If you wear a maid outfit, you will be great at this job too ...

Intimacy.transcription:
Do children in Tokyo ... wear nice clothing?
Oh, I just brought it up. Please do not mind me.

Chitchat I.transcription:
N- No, I won't steal anything anymore ...
E-even if I take something by accident, I will return it right away ...
Yes ...

Chitchat II.transcription:
「なくな雁　今日から我も　旅人ぞ」
... I spoke about the past with customers at the cafe once. This Haiku was taught by them.

Monologue.transcription:
A safe place, clean clothes, delicious food, a stable job ...
All these are like a dream. Thinking of waking up from this is ... terrifying.

Deployment.transcription: Group crime ... Oh, no. It's nothing.

Pre-Battle.transcription: では、いってきます。

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: 手加減は致しませんよ。

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Time to admire the cherry blossoms.

Battle Victory.transcription: Is it over? That's great. Let's go back together.

Insight.transcription: Th-Thank you so much for your care ...

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Something seems to have changed, but ... not really.

First Encounter.transcription:
Hello, I'm the Necrologist.
I am adept at listening to and managing others' affairs.
This of course includes yours as well, whether in the present or perhaps, in the future.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
There are still many tombstones like this in the museum.
They get exceptionally noisy when it starts raining.

To the Future.transcription:
The future? There's no real difference between the present and the future.
People die and there'll always be tombstones speaking of their desires, always a necrologist fulfilling those wishes.
I can't imagine another necrologist fulfilling my wishes when I'm dead.

Idle.transcription:
1930s Porno Clippings in the attic ...
My apologies. Allow me to correct myself.
It's the "1930s Girls' Sensual Parts Clippings". I'll look for them.
Hmm? You want me to destroy them as soon as possible?

Greetings.transcription:
Hello, welcome to the Tombstone Mus ...
My apologies, I'm losing it a little from all that I've had to do.

Morning.transcription:
I'll sweep away the dust that's gathered on the tombstones from the previous night.
While the physical body might have passed, it is still important to look neat and tidy.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning. Here is the zopf that I've prepared for you.
No, it isn't any tombstone's desire. It's just a little wish of mine.

Night.transcription:
Tombstones don't need rest. They'll chatter incessantly whether it's night or day,
which is why I have chronic insomnia.
No worries. It's all part of being a necrologist.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Could you please have a chat with me?
Uh, I just ... I haven't talked to someone who's alive for quite a while.
If you've got the time ...

When communicating with someone, always make sure to look right at them, and do keep your gaze gentle.
This will help them accept the hard truth, which will prevent them from getting hysterical.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
I've touched both solid, rambling tombstones filled with regret,
as well as frail shoulders trembling with grief.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:

I'm sure you can understand ... the places that I've gone to are mostly funerals.

Hobby.transcription:
The tombstones will leave once their wishes are fulfilled, and they will stay in the glass display for all eternity after.
They'll never be cold to the touch and instead, turn silent and warm.

Praise.transcription:
You're a very good listener. It's not just the dead, but even the living are willing to tell you their wishes.
You possess gentleness and that sort of incredible ability.

Intimacy.transcription: Do you think ... getting attention from a necrologist is a bad thing?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Do you know Stonehenge?
I believe it's made of tombstones, though they're just a lot larger than ordinary ones.
I really want to go there myself one day, just so I can listen to their desires.

What would you like to tell her?
"I've never forgotten you"?
Alright, I see.

Death is merely an extension of life, which everybody is subject to. Everyone gets to that point someday.

Mhmm, mhmm ... I will take you back.

The pleads and laments of the dead are rushing toward me like snow.

Aloha! Welcome to ...

What do you mean "they are into flying objects"
... a flying object, like me?!

Hat and Hair.transcription: Metal, plastic, or other materials, it doesn't matter.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Cow ... Cow?! What cow?! This is not a cow ...
My dear friend, this is ...
this is the DUU-DUU-BELL-BOO that lives on the back side of the atmosphere!
That's ... Yes, that's what it's called!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
... Fresh and healthy, right?
I regularly provide it energy, and that's the only entertainment I have.
Grow some grass! Be a gardener! ... Egh.

Hobby.transcription:
If you have any clue about dispelling the effect of the "shrink and imprison" incantation,
please tell me ... No, not for me, I have a friend who ...

Praise.transcription: Being such an erudite, do you also have some missions?

Intimacy.transcription:
May I come with you next time you go out?
I just ... want to hang out.

Chitchat I.transcription:
What Susie said to her husband was the opposite to the reality.
It is called lying, a skill that mastered by many creatures.
It is troublesome, yet convenient.

Chitchat II.transcription:
... Arcanist, the biggest variate in my investigation and observation.
We never knew your existence. You are huge ...
New friends, brand new friends to us.

Monologue.transcription:
... These emotional words, I shouldn't have told anybody.
But I have family, I miss them too. How long haven't I seen them?
T-9910.2 and C-00138,
I can barely remember the color of their outboard window's coating.

Deployment.transcription: Who knew an investigator will need to do such a thing.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hello! Hello!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: My friend! Dance together with DUU-DUU-BELL-BOO!

Battle Victory.transcription: That's a lot of data. I have full confidence in the future.

Insight.transcription:
Thank you so much, my dear human friend.
Thinking about the future, I'm really sorry.

First Encounter.transcription:
Hello!
No no no! Come back here! I won't ... I won't crawl out of the screen ...

Suitcase Climate.transcription: Ahhh, my signal! Lightning, incoming!

To the Future.transcription:
Well, the future is like a cat in the box!
I will admit it is compelling.
But I think ... I'm not ready for it.

Idle.transcription:
Err, hello? Someone forgot to turn off the TV!
Anyone there? Heeellooo!

Greetings.transcription:
Ohh! Finally made up your mind to share some secrets with me?
Grab those onion rings and popcorn and come closer. Yes ... tell it to my ear.

Morning.transcription:
Good morning, any interesting gossip ...
Oh, you want the morning news? Fine, I'm out.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning! Ah, you are having Sprinkle Spangles! Shame that I can't have any ...
Or shall we run a simulation?
Come, I will open my mouth, and you will take a spoonful in front of the screen and act like you're going to feed me, aaaaah ...

Night.transcription:
Hey, you, you you you ...
really gonna spend a nice evening on these boring stories of hell?
Hell no, I'd better get the hell out of here!

Bond: Night.transcription:
Come over here! Put this TV down on the ground!
Ooh! I haven't lay down in ages, I almost forgot how comfortable this can be.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Hey! Stop smacking! The signal is alright!

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
These are not my hands.
But if you want to feel them ... you can try touching the electric current ...

Clothing and Torso.transcription: What to watch now—The Fitness Girl.

Hobby.transcription:
The bottom of the drawer, the confessional, a locked cabinet ...
Diaries, reminder booklets, and notes hidden in the jacket's pocket ...

Praise.transcription: Hey! Can I have your autograph? Like those celebrities on TV!

Intimacy.transcription:
It's great that you don't have to pay for electricity here.
Just imagine what the bill would have looked like!
But even if you had to pay, you'd leave the TV on for me, because I'm worth it, right?

Chitchat I.transcription:
This place is not as interesting as you thought it would be. People have locked away many things ...
Locks ... over locks.

Chitchat II.transcription:
What ... is ... going ... wrong?
Turn it ... off and ... on again, or unplug the TV!
Don't you ... know ... a restart solves ... everything!

Monologue.transcription:
It's not about the size or depth of a secret,
even the least important thing can be intriguing once it's intentionally covered up.
Just like the candy jar on top of the wardrobe. It always has my curiosity.

Deployment.transcription: What, what? Make space for me!

Pre-Battle.transcription: Let me hear it, let me hear it!

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: I never expected this from you!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Oh? Mhmm, mhmm! Ohh ... This is breath-taking!

Battle Victory.transcription: The TV always prevails! This is the power of amusement!

Insight.transcription: Thank you for your "secret" service!

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Woooh! Fully charged!

First Encounter.transcription:
Hey, Jefe. Life is a gamble.
Miracles won't happen if you just sit around and wait for it. When exactly are you going to make a bet?

Suitcase Climate.transcription: I bet you the weather's gonna clear up in three hours.

To the Future.transcription:
The future–will the future bring more thrilling adventures?
Think about it. Isn't it always like this in those exaggerated novels?
Arcanum will eventually destroy the world and render everything to ruins!

Idle.transcription: Slot machines, Blackjack, Russian Roulette ... Hah.

Greetings.transcription: Oh, Jefe. Take a seat. Don't stand on ceremony.

Morning.transcription:
Morning ... Huh?
If my memory didn't fail me, I must have fallen asleep at the back of some truck last night ...

Bond: Morning.transcription:
You're just in time. Shall we have breakfast together?
I got some spicy burritos ... you don't like it?
What about enchiladas? ... It's not about the type of food?

Night.transcription: It's night! It's night! Let the gamble begin!

Bond: Night.transcription:
I was born holding this coin, but I have no idea where it came from ...
It's like a friend that's been accompanying me all these years, yet I don't even know its name.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Want some of my good luck? If you think it'll work, try me!

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Here, let's shake hands! Buena chica!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
If you want to be healthy, take care of what you eat. It doesn't feel good when you get an upset stomach.
I once had a companion who would eat soil, screws and whatnot!
Frightening, isn't it?

Hobby.transcription:
Ooh, it's you, Jefe? Wanna go on an adventure?
There are over 261.6 places that have been rated as dangerous.
Murder scenes or cliffs, it's your call.

Praise.transcription:
You'll definitely win a lot. Trust me, I'm never wrong.
Every single slot machine in Las Vegas is like my babysitter. I know them!

Intimacy.transcription:
Are you ready to do this with me?
Everyone's jaws are going to drop and the ratings are going to soar like the eagles!

Chitchat I.transcription: Wherever the coin goes, I go too ... It's always been this way.

Chitchat II.transcription:
I'm often the object of people's jealousy because I'm too lucky,
but as you know, with my luck, nobody can do anything to me.

Monologue.transcription:
Stability? Safety? For a life like that,
you might as well just give me a poison apple and let me sleep!
Remember to kiss me awake when there's something fun going on!

Deployment.transcription: Is the camera in place?

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hey, give me a chip. Just one with the lowest denomination.

Select Ultimate.transcription: Now, let me choose two lucky guests!

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: Hey, hey, hey! Don't be shy, mi amigo. Let's dance!

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: What? You still don't recognize me? What about now?

Cast Ultimate.transcription:
Ladies and gentlemen, this is no magic nor any special kind of mechanism.
Wish us ... luck!

Battle Victory.transcription: Whoa, seven, siete, sept!

Insight.transcription:
Heh, everyone's guessing who is this "Jefe" always supporting me,
letting me stir up trouble on TV.
... Wanna show up?

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Not enough oxygen. I feel like ... I'm about to fly!

First Encounter.transcription:
Hello. Could you help me?
Over there, please. Thank you.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
The melody-like sound of rain drops on the window is always here,
accompanying me through the long long night.

To the Future.transcription:
The doctor says that as long as I work hard, my disease will be cured.
At that time, I could run freely, just like other children.
But ... in case there is any accident, please give this letter to my mom.

Idle.transcription: Shh, please don't speak too loudly. Ms. Timekeeper is having a rest.

Greetings.transcription:
Ah, I'm so glad you are here.
How was your day?

Morning.transcription: Good morning. I brushed my hair by myself today. How do I look?

Bond: Morning.transcription: Sorry, when I thought that today we can read the book together, I was too excited to sleep well ...

Night.transcription:
You have already worked very hard, please take a break at the right time.
Shall we ... read this book together?

Bond: Night.transcription:
The dinner is really delicious.
Although my mouth always tastes like rust, I can still feel it.
Thank you chef. Thank you Ms. Babyblue for the fruit candies.
And of course, thank you for staying with me.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Are you patting my head?
The doctor says, this is a reward for good children. Have I done something right?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Would you like to hold my hands? I could be with you any time.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Ms. nurse says that my body is "like a leaf that can be blown away by a gust of wind."
But it's really fun to be blown away.
I always wanted to fly once *coughs* ... Sorry.

Hobby.transcription:
I want to have a try at "travelling," like in the books.
But first, I want to climb up the hillside that I can't see clearly from the window.

Praise.transcription:
Turn the impossible into possible. Be brave and never shy away.
You are completely different from others. You raised my hope.

Intimacy.transcription:
Are there really hundreds of countries out there? Tens of thousands of people?
Oh, there's a hole on the tree in the yard. Does the squirrel family really live there?

Chitchat I.transcription:
If there is something bothering you, please feel free to chat with me at anytime.
Although I can't get around as much as everyone else, I can still do the talking!

Chitchat II.transcription:
Please teach me how to use arcanum and master it better,
so that I could recover and not get sick again.
Maybe ... mom will not cry for me anymore.

Monologue.transcription:
Not only mom and dad, all the nurses grieved and cried about my "misfortune" ...
Sometimes I think, maybe it's me who brings them tears and sorrows ...
I am so sorry about that ...

Deployment.transcription: Thank you for taking me out.

Pre-Battle.transcription: It's very nice to meet you!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: It protects me, as the doctor says.

Battle Victory.transcription: Really? We did it. That's great!

Insight.transcription: I ... I'd like to try to stand up ... May I?

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Thank you for visiting me. Thank you for your flowers.
I have never really touched them myself. I'm really ... really grateful to you.

First Encounter.transcription:
Have you heard that story? A magical golden lamp,
rub it 3 times and there was a genie, who can satisfy all your wishes?
Yes you say? Well then, go to that guy instead!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
It is said in a foggy day, there will be ... a faceless ghost～
Ha!
Haha haha.

To the Future.transcription:
People always toss coins and talk about their future wishes ...
So why don't they start it right now?

Idle.transcription:
If you come back now, you will hear my weird wish collection!
Hey ... are you there?

Greetings.transcription: First, just to be sure, you didn't bring any coins, did you?

Morning.transcription:
Birdie ... birdie, talk to me.
... Though I don't understand a word.

Bond: Morning.transcription: Ah ... Morning morning! Nice, finally wasn't woken up by any coins.

Night.transcription: OK, that's all for today's spring visit. Go home, people! You are dismissed!

Bond: Night.transcription:
I can't sleep yet ... Who knows if the daydreamers will come back?
... Just like this. Whoosh! And the coin falls into the jar!
You have to protect me!

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Sacrilegious!
... Isn't it?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: So, why am I holding a jar?

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Hey!! It tickles! Don't do that!

Hobby.transcription:
People always make up those stories: they've met angels, their dreams come true ...
Unfortunately, it's me they've met!

Praise.transcription: Well done! I'll give you my permission to wash your hands in this jar ... once only!

Intimacy.transcription: I've heard girls on the outside world wear fashionable clothes ... May I have a try?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Hey, the Arcanum water purification unit ... You mentioned it before ...
What is it?

Chitchat II.transcription:
There once was a very kind guy.
He took away my coins, here, one by one carefully ...
Wait, that's the so-called thief? What ...

Monologue.transcription:
What's in the jar, you ask? Gold, jewelry, pine cones ...?
No no no, there is and there always is, spring water.

Deployment.transcription: Hee hee, I got the whole jar of water.

Pre-Battle.transcription: I can also grant my enemies' wishes ... in my own way!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: No! More! Wishes! To! Me!

Attacked I.transcription: It's gonna break ... It's gonna break ...

Battle Victory.transcription: The triomphe of the wise La Source for sure!

Insight.transcription:
The jar gets heavier ... or lighter?
It's heavy and light! So weird ... I don't get it!!

First Encounter.transcription:
Oh my lord, what's going on?
We are in the same boat now. You don't mean it, do you?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
There're people bathing in the sun, and others cosseted by the night ...
But someone has to do the dirty work in the foggy days when their faces can't be seen.
Am I right, my lord?

To the Future.transcription:
My plan is to live restfully till tomorrow ...
My dear lord, I don't have time to think that far.

Idle.transcription: If I shoot right now, will my lord be startled?

Greetings.transcription: I am here, behaving myself. My dear lord, don't be oversensitive.

Morning.transcription:
Some kids must be in hunger, right?
Are you doing something about it, my lord? People like you who are such a humanitarian ...

Bond: Morning.transcription: So annoying to put on clothes. Who set this rule? You, my lord?

Night.transcription:
Are you also interested in my arms, my lord? This is no ordinary pistol ...
Ha ha ha, you staring at me so intensely, it makes my muzzle shine in the moonlight.

Bond: Night.transcription: For Italians the night belongs to their lovers and families. That's the best moment.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Ah ... ah ... ah ... Your hand, my lord, it's so warm.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Bang ... Just like this, and then you will see a withering.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Light, slow, unable to grasp, the good things. Do you also like feathers?
You are just like them ... Always tickling my heart.

Hobby.transcription: With the gunshot, the feathers are falling down. Ah, ah ... So beautiful.

Praise.transcription:
My lord, no matter what you do, it makes me comfortable.
What a good lord. You can get any reward you want from me.

Intimacy.transcription:
Hmm ... So dangerous. I almost fell into it.
Come on. If it goes on, I may not be able to control myself someday.

Chitchat I.transcription:
I've heard many stories about "angels,"
but there is only one ending.

Chitchat II.transcription:
When I was young, my sister and I played hide-and-seek in the orange farm.
I hid up a tree, and my hair was covered with the smell of orange blossoms ... It's hard to wash off.

Monologue.transcription:
It is often said "God loves the world,"
but providence always comes when the ending is already set.
Fortunately, I have never, never regretted anything.

Deployment.transcription: Oops, you all look so fierce.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hmm, here I am again.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Che peccato. Sei dalla parte sbagliata.

Battle Victory.transcription: Emm, what a good cooperation.

Insight.transcription: Of course I will repay you well.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: When I sit on that feather, wherever the wind sends me, I will go.

First Encounter.transcription: ... Greetings, madam. I am here.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Clouds help predict the weather, and also affect the air humidity ...
Oh, my wine!

To the Future.transcription:
People are infatuated with time, chasing after immortality. That's the thing that never changes ...
It's the motivation, also the limitation.

Idle.transcription:
Just like Cézanne's 
The Kitchen Table
, Balthus' 
Still Life with a Figure
 ...
Well, I think Caravaggio's 
Basket of Fruit
 is better.

Greetings.transcription: Are you here to confirm this APPLe's expiration date? Don't worry!

Morning.transcription:
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
However, please do not count on this APPLe, will you? My friend.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
The light particles traveling from one medium to a different medium in a parallel direction ...
Um, hi ... good morning.

Night.transcription:
When the side of the earth turns away from the sun, people call it night ...
While in fact, everything stays the same and nothing changes.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Hello, Ms. Vertin ... sssssss ... W-When did you, burp, master my ... optical arcane skill?
But I-I don't see ... any sunlight in here?

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Apples will drop when they're ripe ...
Umm, why am I saying these?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: What are you looking for? I think I ... may not be of help.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
I am not heavy ...
since I have to consider the force that the people sitting under the tree can withstand.

Hobby.transcription: Alcohol can sterilize, disinfect and innerve ... I mean, Sherry is pretty good.

Praise.transcription:
You've read through 
The basic study of alchemy
?
How about 
Theoretical system of nature philosophy
? And 
The trajectories of the planets
?
... You may now be able to discuss more things with this APPLe!

Intimacy.transcription:
About the study of fission and enrichment of the tungsten powder in displacement reaction,
this APPLe considers you as the perfect assistant.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Waffle! Ugh, please don't misunderstand me. It's just a little admonition for this APPLe himself ...
Haven't the posts on this forum been checked?!

Chitchat II.transcription:
I heard that there is a medieval knight wandering around. May I have a look at him ... or his armor?
... Maybe we can talk about wines in the Loire region.

Monologue.transcription:
The shattered memories from the past sometimes haunt me ...
I see the revoluting celestial bodies faraway,
giant telescope and rainbow lights ...

Deployment.transcription: Hmm ... there will be some differences between theory and practice.

Pre-Battle.transcription: You can't see me, you can't see me ...

Select Ultimate.transcription: Don't worry. Weightlessness only lasts a second.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: The star falls towards the sun, as the apple drops to the ground.

Battle Victory.transcription: Which matters more, knowledge or strength?

Insight.transcription:
Marvelous ...
If possible, may this APPLe have one more please?
This APPLe thinks there is still room for formula improvement.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the table ...

First Encounter.transcription: Hello, world.

Suitcase Climate.transcription: Ahh, photosynthesis feels good as always.

To the Future.transcription:
We have our backs to the "past," our feet in the "present," and lead people to the "future."
What a wonderful story.

Idle.transcription: FM, FM, the latest news for you next ...

Greetings.transcription: Welcome ... My good friend.

Morning.transcription:
I've selected some morning news from 249 regions ...
Would you like to know which region consumes the most meat every morning?

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Now, I am going to clean the dust under the battery cover.
Please guard the door for me and don't let anyone get close.

Night.transcription:
Somewhere on Earth, there are always people working ... .
That's why the world is forever awake.

Bond: Night.transcription:
No matter how the world has changed, it looks up to one abiding moon ...
Please rest at ease.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
This will cause me to malfunction, please don't ...
News from yesterday: the latest economic focus meeting has been held on Grazing Hilltop.
Cows attending the meeting believed donut holes and poor pessimists to be the causation of the recent cold wave.
Gold-raising and lava-raising are therefore urgently required ...

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: □■□△！No touching ...!

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Thanks to your careful maintenance, my color stays beautiful and fresh.

Hobby.transcription:
Those fluffy quadrupeds have a long history of such behavior,
using fraudulent appearances to commit some dangerous acts ...
They are not here, right?

Praise.transcription: It's amazing, please allow me to play a song to praise you.

Intimacy.transcription:
Could you put me into the water? Could you leave me near the fireplace?
I have no eyesight, which makes me on tenterhooks.
Please look after me, guide me to feel them, and take me away when necessary.

Chitchat I.transcription:
