Someone once tried to steal me, and stuffed his own ears with earplugs ...
until he later understood that some "voices" cannot be blocked.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Please promise me NOT to open my battery cover, and honor your own word.
I hope you will not be another Psyche, and I won't be the crane flying over the mountains.

Monologue.transcription:
... Every question has an answer, but not every question needs an answer.
Flowers in the garden know nothing, but they still keep blooming.

Deployment.transcription: Alright! Let's try together.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Maybe I should switch to a more exciting channel.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Knowing nothing is also a blessing.

Battle Victory.transcription: Joy of victory is also new knowledge.

Insight.transcription: The moment when dirt bids farewell to the machine is worth remembering forever.

First Encounter.transcription: Hi there, I am Mondlicht. I still have things to do, so I'll be on my way.

Suitcase Climate.transcription: They like foggy days like these the best ...

To the Future.transcription:
Once everything is over and this "future" you are always talking about arrives,
everybody in the village will be able to live peacefully, right?
At that point, I want to ... to go to school ...

Idle.transcription: Oma ... I'll make sure to protect everyone.

Greetings.transcription: It's good that you're back safely.

Morning.transcription: Bread is on the table ... I'm leaving soon.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Oma cleans her rifle multiple times every morning.
"Don't let bullets rust inside," is what she always taught me.
After that ... No, forget it. It's nothing.

Night.transcription:
I need to stand guard, up until the day breaks.
Please get some rest.

Bond: Night.transcription:
I'm still here. I won't let anyone get hurt,
so please rest well. I'll take care of everyone.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Can you smell the blood on this cape?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Don't touch it. It's dangerous.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: The big bad wolves are very bad, but I can handle them.

Hobby.transcription:
The children in the village will go to Anne's house on the Sabbath.
Her mama gives out snacks in the afternoon, and she starts reading storybooks at dusk.
I'll sometimes stop by their window,
but not for long. I need to be back at the lookout before night falls.

Praise.transcription:
Danke.
With your help, I'll definitely ... be able to kill all the big bad wolves.

Intimacy.transcription:
Hey, are you free now?
I found this book in my room. Could you ...

Chitchat I.transcription: Don't trust anything the big bad wolves say. Never let your guard down. Don't respond to them.

Chitchat II.transcription: There isn't soft bread like this in the village. I really want everybody to try it.

Monologue.transcription:
It's all because of the blood we've spilt.
Grandma said ... that the entire river was red that night.
I've never seen that night, but I keep dreaming of that river.
Blood debts must be repaid in kind.

Deployment.transcription: I'm always prepared.

Pre-Battle.transcription: The smell of wolves.

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: Have a taste of this bullet.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Wie du mir, so ich dir.

Battle Victory.transcription: The hunters, no longer have the right to lose in battle.

Insight.transcription: The blood of those monsters shall dye my cloak a deeper red.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: I'll protect every single person. I swear on this red cloak of mine.

First Encounter.transcription:
Listen up! This is Radio APPLe coming at you from 3000 feet above your head!
Catch me if you can!
Now get ready for some rock 'n' roll!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
The sun? It's not a record, nah, more like a cauldron, hot and overflowing with melted gold ...
Hey, think it might work as a potion ingredient?
Maybe we can find something in Sotheby's collection!

To the Future.transcription:
As the Captain, I can assure you THIS is the future!
No "Storm," no enemies, only the coolest world tour ever!

Idle.transcription:
Hey, hey! Getting carried away by the music?
Let's take a break to enjoy a very special program! Radio APPLe is on the air and in the air,
can you hear me?

Greetings.transcription:
Hey, mate! Fancy a safe ride through the air?
Yes, "safe"! Much safer than riding on a broom that doesn't even have a safety belt!

Morning.transcription:
Good morning, bad morning! Goodie good morning, baddie bad morning!
Ready for a "pilot-style" secret handshake?

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Proper breakfast for a pilot should include bacon, eggs, and baked beans,
but we've run out of canned beans, so we'll have to make do with what we have ...
Wait, there was a whole case of canned beans in the kitchen before.
Who ... Must be that number girl!

Night.transcription:
Want to hear what a lullaby sounds like when it goes rock?
Well, no, it might not put you to bed,
but who'd want to miss out on a ROCK LULLABY?!

Bond: Night.transcription:
*makes drum beats*
Look at the stars! The way they twinkle makes you tingle like a new song from the Beatles, doesn't it?
What? Ah, bloody hell! I forgot they broke up already ...

Hat and Hair.transcription:
The hairstyle? Oh, it was done up by Mr. APPLe, my chief mate and barber.
It's saving me a bit of money, you know.
He did do a terrible job the first time, but now he isn't half-bad!

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Everyone needs tools to make their ideas work!
And your hands can be those tools!
So just like how I take care of a ship, keep them well protected!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Nice medal, isn't it? Heh.
It's from Lilya. She said it'd make me look like a proper pilot!

Hobby.transcription:
I wish I could airdrop these records wherever I went.
Then people would know me as the Generous Pirate Captain, Legend of the Open Sky ...
But truth is, I haven't got the money ...

Praise.transcription:
You've always been my best mate, you know that. Rational, reliable, full of genius ideas ...
Now, best mate, I could use your help.
How about you talk the Foundation into getting me the latest engine ...

Intimacy.transcription:
You've got Regulus as your guiding star, bringing rhythm right where you are!
You don't get to meet a star like me every day.
So ... maybe stop looking at that stupid book!

Chitchat I.transcription:
I have to fly less to protect this beautiful ship ...
*sighs* It's my jinx again.
I asked that French classmate of yours to check what'll happen,
and she foresaw another huge explosion in the orbuculum ...

Chitchat II.transcription:
I love how the blowing wind rushes between my fingers ...
Someone once told me it holds the answers to all life's questions!

Monologue.transcription:
People don't think much of airships these days; it reminds me of how they used to rag on rock'n'roll.
"A total waste of time and money,"they'd say.
But then you give it a try and learn just how fantastic it can be.

Deployment.transcription: Hey ho, let's go! Equipment check.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Party in the sky and on the air!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: *finger snaps* That's a sound for a new era!

Battle Victory.transcription: Phew! That was a flight!

Insight.transcription: Hmph ... might be enough for another three records, maybe …

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Know what's waiting for us at the edge of the sky?
Not silly old clouds or some bird with diamonds.
It's a Blues Rock tune, bluer than a midnight flight!

0.transcription:
Hmm, something's missing ...
Oh, only the bleeding music!

Lobby Entrance.transcription:
Haha, these hands here belong to an epic captain, a radio rocker, and an ace pilot!
Wait a tick, Chief Mate APPLe was right; my hands are priceless now ...
I ... I gotta get these puppies insured …

Lobby Interaction 1.transcription:
Hey! Keep your prints off the captain's glasses!
If you lot block my sight we'll be in trouble!

Lobby Interaction 2.transcription:
Three, two, one ... Too right I look cool!
But save your compliments for when I reach 300 thousand feet high!

First Encounter.transcription:
Balloons ... you need some balloons here.
That's why I brought them. Say cheese.

Suitcase Climate.transcription: How I wanna tear the clouds apart. A party needs a lawn.

To the Future.transcription:
But, if time stands still, there'll never be the next party.
Ah ... I have to think about it.

Idle.transcription: Interesting ... Maybe I should make a bigger sound?

Greetings.transcription: Oh! Nice to meet you! Nice to meet you! Nice to meet you!

Morning.transcription:
... Oh, I guess I should say "Good morning" now?
Okay, sorry, I forgot it again. Let's start over, lie down please.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Would you like to touch the viscera in the balloon?
They're soft and bouncy, like a jelly.
The jelly best for breakfast.

Night.transcription:
Don't you think it's too quiet? At night, or evening, this time?
Everyone is asleep! What an incredible waste of time! Is that sleep? Or a coma?

Bond: Night.transcription: ... I'm going out. Wanna come with me? Please?

Hat and Hair.transcription:
I keep thinking and thinking about how to hold a party and join it.
Oh—if someone opens my head, you know, just open it!
You'll see the draft of party plans all over the floor like brains.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Boom boom boom!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Starting here, it is called the skull, the collarbone, the ribs, the ulna, the radius
and the rainbow lollipop I hide in my body!

Hobby.transcription:
There is nothing I love more than the smile on a crying kid.
Smile more, everyone.

Praise.transcription:
You're the best party partner, the best kid and adult I've ever met!
Although I don't understand what's a kid and what's an adult,
I just wanna say, you're the best? You know what I mean?

Intimacy.transcription:
Please take my balloon with you,
so that people can see it, and I can find you within a second.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Please, keep those horrible people away from me! I do not want to know any medicine
or potion formula that leaves a bitter taste in the mouth! Yikes!

Chitchat II.transcription:
When I was little, I had a dream.
I saw many kids buried in the ground,
their tiny hands exposed, like newly growing potatoes.
And then I woke up, I started to throw up balloons.

Monologue.transcription:
I wanna be like my parents,
but not exactly the same.
With these balloons, I can do what they can't.

Deployment.transcription: Let us get to know each other.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Let the helium fill your pulmonary lobe!

Select Ultimate.transcription: Where's the party star? Where is it?

Cast Ultimate.transcription:
The story begins with a bad adult.
He did this first, then that, at last ... boom!

Battle Victory.transcription:
It's time to say goodbye! Don't miss me, really, I'll be back!
*sobbing*

Insight.transcription:
I know what you mean. The next party, the bigger party.
Hehee, I'm on it!

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Ah! I see the peaceful families, and the lawns under the sun ...
Kids who are suffering, please come to me!
Or ... I will go to you.

First Encounter.transcription:
The lake is overflowing. It's cold, just like a flowing line ...
Wait, where am I?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Horizon ... the boundary of heaven and earth that may or may not intersect with the earth's surface,
useful to measure the radio waves, and useful to ... make people feel better.

To the Future.transcription:
I hope that in the future I can also contribute to the well-being of mankind ...
However, it would be better to have more missions.

Idle.transcription:
Timekeeper ... Timekeeper? ... Are you asleep?
Okay, please have a good rest. Where is the blanket?
... Mmm, cover yourself and you won't catch a cold.

Greetings.transcription: Greetings! Today your shirt matches the color of your eyes very well.

Morning.transcription:
Good morning! Here's the newspaper today.
Huh? Why are my fingers black ... stained with ink?
How come? I've just touched it ...

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning! Today I read a news story on the Italian Cheek Kissing Greeting ...
Uh, I mean, it would be great if we can practice it.

Night.transcription: These newspapers ... plea ... please do not throw them away until I finish reading!

Bond: Night.transcription:
Is it really ok doing nothing like this?
Ha ... I mean when I was at the Foundation, there had never been such a tranquil night ...
Thank you for teaching me all these things.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Order is more important than opinion ...
I was taught in this way.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
It is said that the world I write down is just my imagination ...
But how can I get closer to the reality? What is ... the boundary between them?

Clothing and Torso.transcription: The Foundation has provided me with much help, including food, uniforms, education ... and goals.

Hobby.transcription:
The joke on November 7th ... I seem to have read it somewhere?
Ah! It was on the issue of February 29th!
... Report! I found a typographical error!

Praise.transcription:
Emotionally stable and responsible; well-planned and capable; gentle, decisive and beautiful ...
Huh? What's going on? Timekeeper? Why is your face covered in your hands?

Intimacy.transcription:
... Here's the newspaper from yesterday. The bridge, can we go there?
It looks really beautiful!

Chitchat I.transcription:
Did you do something amazing just now?
Well, you don't need to explain to me. I can imagine it.

Chitchat II.transcription:
The verses to release arcane skills are not easy to find.
They must be full of passion and well-timed, and can only be found with luck.
However, if I know a poet, maybe ... things will be much easier.

Monologue.transcription:
Sometimes I think about the time ... when we studied together ...
The instructor made us deskmates,
and your pockets are always alive with frogs, stones and toffees.

Deployment.transcription: Just as what's been practiced countless times.

Pre-Battle.transcription: May the peace be with us.

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: You've found the right verse for me.

Select Ultimate.transcription: Depict the world I have never seen before.

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: So long lives this, and this gives power to thee.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Each moment, now night.

Battle Victory.transcription: I will pray for you ... sorry.

Insight.transcription: Hu ... La ringrazio. I will make good use of this power.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
This place has brought me so many things: freedom, fresh knowledge, brave friends.
How can I ever repay you?
I want to be of help to you at any time.

First Encounter.transcription:
Silence.
Speak. From whence dost thou hail and what is thy purpose?

Suitcase Climate.transcription: The flames of injustice are yet to burn at the stake on rainy days. All is not yet lost.

To the Future.transcription:
There are numerous injustices in the world.
The law cannot prevail over power, but there shalt eventually be a sword sharp enough to cut it down.

Idle.transcription: Silence.

Greetings.transcription: Speak.

Morning.transcription:
Oh? Thou art early.
I think thou were like those lords ...
No, 'tis of no concern.

Bond: Morning.transcription: There is much to be done today. I will be on my way after greeting thee.

Night.transcription: The trial today hath ended. Was it fair? Certainly.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Everything I doth ...
is so I may enjoy this calm wind on nights like this, rather than hear the sorrowful cries and moans of unhappiness.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Thou art overstepping my boundaries, arcanist.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: If a greedy hand commits a crime, it shalt be cut off.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: This body is a representation of justice. Laziness is not permitted.

Hobby.transcription:
The idle chatter of the people is entertaining,
but 'tis more entertaining that they are always the first to know about the corrupt behavior of nobles.

Praise.transcription: We seem to be on a similar path. Keep going, o' ... friend of mine.

Intimacy.transcription:
Those who hurt others shalt eventually be the ones dripping with blood. Makers of injustice shalt be visited by justice.
I have seen the righteous wielding much power fall to it.
When I succumb, do not be merciful.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Thou cannot trust those greedy gents to abide by the law.
Thou must pick up thy sword, hold it to their throats, and the law can then prevail.

Chitchat II.transcription:
They cried bitterly afore the trial, then threw a handful of fine salt at me ...
Next? They repented by apologizing profusely.

Monologue.transcription:
There shall always be those who think themselves above others and ensure it with their power, wealth and wickedness.
If they keep the commandment of the strong judging the weak, they should not have complaints.

Deployment.transcription: Silence.

Pre-Battle.transcription: This trial is mine to judge.

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: Pay for thy sins with thy blood.

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: Noble or lowly, sin shall be punished.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Thou shalt make an atonement for thy sins in full.

Battle Victory.transcription: Using troops? Pfft.

Insight.transcription: Trials are akin to flames.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: It concerns me that I can imagine how it feels to be in a position of power.

First Encounter.transcription:
Are you a brave speaker?
You look like one ... Hmm, and sound like too.

Suitcase Climate.transcription: Seeds will grow up with the kiss of raindrop ... So does hope.

To the Future.transcription:
I've planned to have a new job a long long time ago ...
but "now" is not the time.

Idle.transcription:
Be quiet, my old pal ...
You always let me hear everything clearly. Ha ...

Greetings.transcription: I'm not good at dealing with visitors ... It reminds me of something bad.

Morning.transcription: I brought you a flower, go find it in the woodpecker house by the street.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
... Didn't sleep well? That's for sure!
You know who else didn't sleep well? The family on the other side of the monitor.
Poor baby was sick and cried all night. All of us are exhausted.

Night.transcription: The darkness swallows the sun, the starlight quietly leaks out of its belly.

Bond: Night.transcription:
The Stasi is watching everyone and everything, except people's dreams.
Sleep ... Go find your own promise land.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Wearing headphones for too long will give you a headache.
Don't be surprised, everyone has had it,
although we seem poker-faced and indifferent.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
I don't recommend you read those reports.
Firstly, it's really boring. And secondly, the Stasi may find you.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Someone once wanted to scratch his back but ended up caught in the tree ...
Of course he didn't know it was me who called help for him.

Hobby.transcription:
I—bought half jar of Lübeck marzipan in a small store ...
Try some? Not much left, don't eat too fast!

Praise.transcription: You're doing the same thing as I do ... No, you're far braver than me.

Intimacy.transcription:
Hm? I seem to hear the sound of "contraband" ...
Don't want to share with me?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Do you know where you can see flowers? In a parterre or in a garden?
Neither, my friend, you should go under the bridge where even a tramp will find it too dirty to spend a night.
Only on the mud-coatted walls of the aperture can you see the most beautiful cornflowers' ... graffiti.

Chitchat II.transcription:
At least for once, I want to check up on the kids on the other side of the monitor ...
Well, we've never met in person, but they are already my old acquaintances.

Monologue.transcription:
To act like an idealist may be too big a goal, but "to be a nice person" doesn't sound bad either ...
Will they write a sonata about me too?

Deployment.transcription: Shall I "ask" the enemy for their tactics?

Pre-Battle.transcription: Finally, some interesting work.

Select Incantation II.transcription: Whose heart is beating so loud?

Select Ultimate.transcription: We should listen to what people say.

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: Agents have guns. It's called common sense.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Secrets always hide in careless words ... Listen carefully.

Attacked I.transcription: Hey, I am the support staff ...

Attacked II.transcription:
Retreat!
... What, I can't make the call?

Battle Victory.transcription:
Stay low-profile.
I don't want to be shunted to some radical department ...

Insight.transcription:
Technically, these are all contraband ...
Now you are my accomplice.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
The times never stop. Maybe I can't change anything ...
But at least I've once spoken out.

First Encounter.transcription:
I'm Oliver Fog, special commissioner of the London Climate Management Agency.
Three hours from getting off ... Ok, let's start.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
What a lovely day ...
I want to go for a walk. We couldn't have asked for a better sun where I lived.

To the Future.transcription:
You really want to go to the future?
... Do you think those smog factory will destroy the whole world?

Idle.transcription:
Rest time is also included in work time.
Both office workers and British people should master the talent of looking for tea time.

Greetings.transcription:
You're here ...
Hey, maybe you can help me with my homework?

Morning.transcription:
The last time I was in the mood for a morning walk was when all I had to do was go to school.
... Still vivid in my mind.

Bond: Morning.transcription: ... Getting up is easier in the summer. In the winter, it's not easy work.

Night.transcription:
Being off duty, such a wonderful resting time.
Well, now let me prepare my book bag ...

Bond: Night.transcription:
... Sometimes I think that you may need to have more rest.
People with great responsibility are always absorbed by their work
and neglect many other things.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
The Fogwalker's hat doesn't fit me, it's too heavy ...
Although my father honored it very much, it's just a job.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
You can't catch the fog ... The only thing you can catch are the things that can be caught ...
like catching the time to get off work.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
A small lad with a lot of thoughts.
That's what many people think about me. But I think they're numb.
It may not be a bad thing to love your job, but isn't it a good thing to love your life?

Hobby.transcription: The yellow daffodil is the prettiest flower. It reminds me of the glorious St David's Day holiday.

Praise.transcription: It is said that "Able men are always busy." Your high working efficiency may bring you harm.

Intimacy.transcription: Uh ... I really don't want to get up today, please just tell others you haven't seen me.

Chitchat I.transcription: I'm planning to write to the queen about lowering the retirement age of some special types of work.

Chitchat II.transcription:
There are people who do screw driving, juggling, dung picking, so of course there are people dealing with the fog.
People who have hands should work, either for living, for self-achieving ...
or other things.

Monologue.transcription:
They had claimed that the Fogs are incredibly essential to London.
In that case, why didn't they put the emission reduction plan on the agenda earlier?

Deployment.transcription: I seldom work together with others, but this is not bad.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Very well, the enemies don't seem to be in the habit of wearing gas masks.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: ... Just take it as a trip to London.

Battle Victory.transcription:
3 hours 15 minutes left ...
No, nothing, let's move on to the next.

Insight.transcription:
If everyone could make such an effort,
perhaps London would have been freed from the fog a long time ago ...
Of course, the faster way is to shut down those factories.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
If the fog in London fades, I will be a special effects artist for stage or film ...
the kind that specializes in making smoke.

First Encounter.transcription:
Ah! The troopers are here! Get out of ...
Huh? You are not one of them? I am so, so sorry!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
What a nice day. There will be such a large audience to ... night.
Ah! My stomach, it hurts ... so much ... I'm not lying!

To the Future.transcription:
Even if we do go back to the future, I still wanna go back farming ...
Grow some potatoes, corn, raise some cattle.

Idle.transcription:
Silence on the stage is only a tiny lingering charm
before the next magnificent show ...
Um, what am I talking about!
... Whew, thank goodness nobody noticed me.

Greetings.transcription: I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

Morning.transcription:
Beautiful sunshine means a beautiful day ...
Hmm, people like me, who cannot do anything well, really don't deserve to be standing in the sun ...

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning. Why am I in a good mood today, you ask?
Because the company takes a day off.

Night.transcription: Everyone else is ready? Mmm ... my feet ... I can't move my feet!

Bond: Night.transcription: The light is on ... It's time for me to go on stage.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
The illusion I create can only fool the eyes ...
My arcane skill is not of much use.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: If none of these troubles had happened ... I would probably be milking the cow right now ... *sighs*

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
... It's indeed too much!
I've told the cast do not pick this outfit ...

Hobby.transcription:
Only when standing on the stage, when saying the lines ...
Could I forget the fact that I'm such a useless, undeserving person ...

Praise.transcription:
Br ... brilliant! Your achievements are soaring like a harrier in the sky,
one can only admire but not be cynical.

Intimacy.transcription: I ... I will be brave ... Just like you!

Chitchat I.transcription:
People, people! Why are we wooing for our own destruction?
Why not just take my word and go back home farming?!

Chitchat II.transcription: An't be my destiny, so. An't be not, so. He that dies this year is quit for the next.

Monologue.transcription:
Each one of us struggles to survive for a certain reason.
Bloodline, responsibility, pursuit, vocation ...
If the illusion I created could be one of their reasons ...
that would be enough.

Deployment.transcription: Don ... don't look at me ... I'm not the one you saw on the wanted list ...

Pre-Battle.transcription:
Did the show begin?
Excellent, get ready to step onto the stage.

Select Ultimate.transcription: This shall be my only act!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Thy ending is destined.

Battle Victory.transcription:
That's what you've got?
... Huh? I'm sorry!

Insight.transcription: Umm ... Are you sure you're not making a mistake ... choosing me?

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Aye ... aye!
Be it tyrant or tyranny, people's right for joy cannot be snatched away.

First Encounter.transcription:
I am ... Who am I? I don't know ...
It's okay, in Wonderland ... everyone is Alice ...

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
It's so strange to see ... the raindrops falling from the sky.
In Wonderland, it is either syrup or sewing needles. I have a lot of umbrellas there.

To the Future.transcription:
You always care about the future.
But Wonderland has been the same for hundreds and thousands of years.
There is nothing wrong with standing still.

Idle.transcription:
What are you doing? What are you looking at?
Do you also have your Wonderland to deal with?
A busy world that ... we never know?

Greetings.transcription: ... Huuu, hm? ... Hm.

Morning.transcription:
MRE-flavored cake, cake-flavored MRE,
which one would Miss Badge prefer?

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Still too early to go to bed? Everyone in Wonderland is waiting for us.
If it goes on like this, time will not be happy ...

Night.transcription:
Shrink the dinner to be swallowed in ... one bite ...
Then, I could finish it as quickly as possible.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Everyone in the dream is waiting for me. Close your eyes and listen.
Outside the door, it's the sound of the heel stepping on the grass ...
Are you not coming with me today?

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Since I came to Wonderland, no one has braided my hair ...
so they are getting longer and longer, longer and longer.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Are you looking for candies? Maybe you should bring a magnifying glass.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
I seem to be taller and taller ... The chair is getting too small to seat me ...
If I shrink myself, will everything be as usual like before?

Hobby.transcription:
There's a teddy bear as big as a mountain in my room.
And there're bears that love honey in the circus box.
Why are there no bears in Wonderland? Hmm ... I will find the bear.

Praise.transcription: I will ask Mr. Rabbit to prepare one more cake ... Hmm ... It's a reward for you ...

Intimacy.transcription: One day, if I go back and never come out again, will you come to visit me?

Chitchat I.transcription:
Time paused? I think we should hurry up to buy teacups.
More and more teacups. We won't have time to wash them very soon.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Twinkle twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are.
Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky. Twinkle, twinkle ...

Monologue.transcription:
People at school once called me ... Umm, how do you say that word?
Ah ... Crazy! Sad? I'm not sad ...
They told me that the most outstanding people were all crazy ...

Deployment.transcription: Are you also here ... for the tea party?

Pre-Battle.transcription: I am not afraid of you. You are just a pile of cards.

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: Let's play peekaboo ... I will help you!

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: Smaller than the stars, bigger than the mushrooms.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Snack time! ... Yum yum.

Battle Victory.transcription:
Is everyone seated? Ahem, the court is now in session.
The verdict is ... guilty!

Insight.transcription: The boundary of Mr. Rabbit and the Queen is getting bigger and bigger.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
What should I give you in return?
A teddy bear? Hmm, or a well filled with syrup?

First Encounter.transcription:
Mission accepted ...
Advice, you'd better clear your complaint mailbox first.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
You know what? Rain can wash away many things,
tire marks, footprints, bloodstains, let alone some dying message written in blood ...
Anyway, I do love rainy days.

To the Future.transcription:
I really don't get why you guys work so hard.
It's a good time, full of delicious desserts and clubs.
Hey, have some juice, little girl,
or should I say ... our great heroine and goddess.

Idle.transcription:
Peter, Andrea, Maleficent, Tonika, Leon ... is everybody awake?
It's time for something different.
... Don't drool everywhere, Andrea!

Greetings.transcription: Come in, it's fine, just be careful not be eaten by them.

Morning.transcription:
You guys always freak me out when you sleep. What kind of people need such a long sleep like that?
Fall in a coma like a crispy critter, and wake up 8 hours later.
... Only god knows how you do that.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Ok, amico mio, a brand new day, let's go shopping!
Why are you so confused? You do know how horrible your fridge is, right?
Its refrigeration is a piece of shit, making my Gelato frozen solid!

Night.transcription: Nice moon, makes me wanna howl.

Bond: Night.transcription:
What do you count before sleep? Sheep or wolf?
I suggest you counting wolves, cause they'll eat up all the sheep ...
and you can enjoy your night.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Wanna know how many holes I've made on others' heads?
No? Then stop it.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
You've noticed?
These hands can wring one's neck, pull the trigger, slice throat with knife ...
Perfect hands.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Cool as hell, right? It's called the Piemonte Art ...
The salesman said so!

Hobby.transcription:
I always take souvenirs from my prey.
Rings, earrings, photos and movie tickets in the wallet, huh ...
I got a beautiful cabinet for my collections, you wanna see?

Praise.transcription:
I mean, if I were the boss, I would hire people like you too.
Although sometimes you are freaking stupid, you gotta be useful somehow, right?

Intimacy.transcription: You wanna some Gelato? All the doctors say it's unhealthy ... but who cares?

Chitchat I.transcription:
You do know James Burton, the one who published the reminiscences?
He made tons of money through that single book. I should ask him for some royalties,
it's all about me after all.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Mio padre was missing, mia madre is in the asylum.
I can't remember her face, but vaguely recall the rhyme she sang me ...
She's in Rome, probably in her middle age. I've never visited her.

Monologue.transcription:
Go back to Rome, where the wolves were born. Said my former boss.
He knew I was born in Rome, but didn't know I was raised in Piemonte.
He was such a fool, even tried to kill me. So I only kept his tie clip.
I didn't tell him that as long as the night will come, everywhere I live is Piemonte.

Deployment.transcription: Huh ... lemme see who will be my poor teammates.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Let the work begin!

Select Ultimate.transcription: I'll give you the time to pray ... as if possible.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Ciao, amore!

Battle Victory.transcription: Viva il mio maestro!

Insight.transcription:
The whispering between wolves and the moon of each night ...
You make me understand them better. What a greedy but brave decision.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Hey, I didn't know you value me so much. What do you want from me?

First Encounter.transcription:
Y'all wanna fries, burgers, or apple Martini?
The party's gonna begin, sit tight ... my naughty guest!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
... Ha! What a fresh air!
Rains help crops grow better. I love raining!
Let's fixin' out and have a walk!

To the Future.transcription:
I hope one day people can accept my job just like they can do to the farmers and the dove keepers.
Mammy would lemme lay on her knees and listen to all the stuff that happened today,
no matter good or bad.

Idle.transcription:
Welcome!
No no no it's a bit faster, and more energetic ...

Greetings.transcription: Huh? Where is my hankie?

Morning.transcription: Good morning, good morning, good morning!

Bond: Morning.transcription: Who wants some Bunny Bunny yummy brekker?

Night.transcription:
Hi, it's club time! You wanna grab a drink?
Don't worry, we have 143 different choices here!

Bond: Night.transcription:
Hey! How about malt beer?
Don't worry if you get drunk, you can always count on Bunny Bunny. Always!

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Oh, hey! Mama ain't no like a droopy girl!
Help me get it up, hurry!

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
I can hold you with a single arm.
If you don't feel so good, just call me, dear guest!

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Whoa, haha ... sorry, it's my belly ...

Hobby.transcription:
I sure like so many things ... I really, really can't pick one!
You see, I like my job, I like yummy foods, I like everyone, and I like you!

Praise.transcription:
How I wanna clap for you!
... Hmm, when I got a free hand, I sure gonna do it!

Intimacy.transcription:
Could you help me fix the zip on my back? Something's wrong there.
Really? If Mama knows I'll be darned!

Chitchat I.transcription: I can lift anyone with no sweat, except myself!

Chitchat II.transcription:
Alright! At least I done learnt this time,
I ain't walk by that dessert store no more, nor the restaurant!

Monologue.transcription:
Back in the village, only my auntie talks about movies with me.
She'd listened to all my faraway and impractical dreams.
I sure am grateful to her. I write her all the time.
And her writing back always smells like apple flower.

Deployment.transcription: Howdy, howdy, howdy! Howdy to everyone!

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hi! Would you like a fruit cut first?

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Hey hoo ... Whoa whoa whoa! Whew, are you ready to have a hearty meal!

Battle Victory.transcription: Bad guys are all gone, no worries!

Insight.transcription:
Unbelievable! You don't think ... I can lift a car?
We ... we might could go out and try ...?

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Really? Oh ... Really! I done loved it, thank you!

First Encounter.transcription:
Здравствуйте ...
No, nothing ...
The name is ... on the paper ...
Please ... have a look ...

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Have you ever wondered ... why does it rain ...?
Not about how ... but, um ... but why.

To the Future.transcription:
The future ... There may be Tsar no more ...
But, I won't go back to the St. Petersburg either ...
I like the bise in the Far East ... and ... зима.

Idle.transcription: ... Всему живущему идти путем зерна.

Greetings.transcription: I'm not ... writing ... poems ...

Morning.transcription: The in ... inspiration always comes at night ... till now.

Bond: Morning.transcription: ... You're awake? Would you like to hear ... my work from last night ...?

Night.transcription: Just one more page ...

Bond: Night.transcription:
Now ... now I'm going out for a walk ...
The moonlight is ... beautiful ... It's good for writing ...
Maybe ... you should try to write a poem too.

Hat and Hair.transcription: Inspirations ... are elusive ... They come and go, as they please.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: Think much ... Write less ... just like chatting.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Warm ... Wind-proof ... шуба.
Everyone should have it.

Hobby.transcription: Perhaps ... I once, too, was a lively bird.

Praise.transcription: You've won my respect ... Although it might not help ...

Intimacy.transcription: Зима is close to you ... it's not just an assumption ...

Chitchat I.transcription:
The throne of the Tsar is covered in heaps of gold ... and stains of blood.
It is dwarfed ... by the firs and the frozen land.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Write when you want ... stop when you don't.
There are not many poems like the orange hair thinks.

Monologue.transcription:
The fallen Tsar is just like the fallen leaves on the island. зима, do you know, what the Tsar is?
You walk so quietly ...

Deployment.transcription: C ... can I, not go ...?

Pre-Battle.transcription: ... Not even close to the soldiers.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Не было бы счастьe, да несчастьe помогло.

Battle Victory.transcription: Хорошо! I'll go back, then ...

Insight.transcription: Зима, poems, are my expressions.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
I hear ... more sounds ...
from animals, trees, oceans and ... poems.

First Encounter.transcription:
Don't panic, my lord,
<The chasing troopers are also part of the play.>

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
When the rain drops, the sorrow follows. Something shall befall the present day.
<Murder, love, or the eulogistic end of a story—>
the dramatic rain!

To the Future.transcription:
Future is an interesting issue, my lord.
I yearn for the wheel of the busy stage moving forward, so do you.
<My friend of one mind, I'll give thee a wind.>

Idle.transcription:
In the ancient times, the fool's job is to entertain the lord ...
<Dost thou also need this service?>

Greetings.transcription: The moment you step onto the stage,<it comes clear to me that the hero hath arrived. >

Morning.transcription:
Greetings to you, my lord.
Your arrival may be the reason of Master Charlie's attendance for rehearsal.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
<Where did they go?>
They all went to work.
<And?>
And they went to church!
<O? Why not go to the play? Why not sing? >
Because long live the all mighty King!

Night.transcription: I wish you an engrossing dream, <leastwise there is no ban for dreams yet.>

Bond: Night.transcription:
<Where did they go?>
They all went to pray.
<And?>
And they came to us, in front of us!
<O! They still love—the entertainment, the song, the skin underneath the dress.>
It's the arrival of the night! Let the play begin!

Hat and Hair.transcription:
My mask? I see not necessity of masking off.
<Aren't thou wearing it too?>

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: I picked this floweret, before it was distained by the blockish world.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Are you confirming my gender?
<Out alas, the Fool hath no gender.>

Hobby.transcription:
What would you do at your leisure?
For me, fishing perhaps, or appreciating silver utensils.
I read no script, I have no script.

Praise.transcription: Listen—audience, they shout all you forth!

Intimacy.transcription:
If none dares stand out and do something to His Grace,
your fair laughter, shall it be heard no more?

Chitchat I.transcription:
The gallows has feet, my lord! Run away when we still can! He is coming!
<His arrival shall kiss all's neck with ropes.> Hahaha!

Chitchat II.transcription:
Who shall stand pensive for tragedy?
Who shall smile through tears for survival?
Who shall pray for their bloody hands?
People—It's people!

Monologue.transcription: Some please people with comic, others with wit. Me, with my life.

Deployment.transcription: Please, allow me to prepare.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Only one fool could stay on the stage, <that shall be me.>

Cast Ultimate.transcription: To that we have free souls forever!

Battle Victory.transcription: Haha, my lord, I defeated one thousand enemies in battle just now!

Insight.transcription: <Sing thee a song I will,> in any voice, any way.

First Encounter.transcription:
Hello dear ...
Do I still have to tell you my name? Or sign my name first?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
If I could take a break all day today, nowhere will I go.
I just want to sing on the balcony.
And on the mist of the window, I will draw many many pussycats.

To the Future.transcription:
Travel to the future? Most welcome!
Maybe I will become more famous, bringing the pictorial to the other side of the world.

Idle.transcription:
Well, it seems I have a rare opportunity to take a break.
Even better if there's a recliner and blanket for me.

Greetings.transcription: It's always lonely to stay somewhere quiet for a long time ...

Morning.transcription:
I read the news every morning,
just to see how the press piece together what they imagine me with exaggerated words.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
While wandering in the bedroom, whenever I see the oval diamond in my jewelry box,
I know that yesterday was not that bad, and today will be good.

Night.transcription:
Hmm ... hah ... a silk robe? Thank you, but I don't want it.
Dress me up with Chanel No.5. Only that is my nightwear.

Bond: Night.transcription:
I often dream of my grandparents coming towards me in a purple mist,
but they never reach my side ... Come closer, would you?

Hat and Hair.transcription:
Blondie, blondie, everyone likes my blonde hair.
I can't believe it is really a technical job to do hair.
Can you? When dyeing ... you need to do this and that ...

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
The cane? That's my "Sweet Nighty Night" ...
How it got its name? I hope you won't have the chance to know.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Rifle for soldier; dress for woman. For me, I got both.

Hobby.transcription:
Will you try three hundred times for a scene less than three seconds?
I tried. For what I love, that's my attitude.

Praise.transcription:
I value your qualities more than your looks.
After all, when it comes to appearance, who will win? You?

Intimacy.transcription:
Wives hate me.
They called me Salome. They call me Lamia. They call me Whore of Babylon, or even Siren ...
but I'm none of them. I'm just ... who I am.

Chitchat I.transcription:
If you want to be a star, come to Hollywood;
if you want to be yourself, then never come.

Chitchat II.transcription: A story for another story; a secret for another secret.

Monologue.transcription:
People spend thousands for my glance.
But you are willing to pay for my soul. Thank you.

Deployment.transcription: Huh, am I not late?

Pre-Battle.transcription: Why haven't those warm-ups walked away?

Select Ultimate.transcription: No memory of the scene will be left.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Nighty night. I wish you sweet dreams.

Battle Victory.transcription: If only I could be as forgetful as them.

Insight.transcription: Gosh! I am even more glamorous now!

Bottom of Insight.transcription: When they sit here, they look down at everyone ... The world is in my hands? ... Huh.

First Encounter.transcription:
Everything in the world is born of laws and regulations.
There are no coincidences, let alone adventures.
There are only expected results, such as our encounter.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
The last time I enjoyed the sun like this was in the afternoon.
I went for an outing in the orphanage.
But later ... they found me.

To the Future.transcription:
The development of the world is like a huge Goldberg machine.
I am curious as to where this little ball of history will lead.

Idle.transcription:
Try my new inventions ...
Ah! I had never prepared for a plan B in your absence ...

Greetings.transcription: It's so nice to meet you! I've been waiting for so long!

Morning.transcription:
Good morning. The timing with which you pushed the door is just right!
The bread in the kitchen should be ready now.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Good morning. I had a dream last night. In my dream, I ... You wanna know?
Come here, let me tell you.

Night.transcription:
What I will show you now is that through these little leather boots ...
The lights will be turned on 30 minutes later!

Bond: Night.transcription: Can I borrow you tonight? I really need your help for my new machine ... please?

Hat and Hair.transcription:
My eyes ... a little scary, aren't they?
Kids new to the orphanage were a little afraid of them, but in the end everyone likes me.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
Haha ... I got you!
I won't let you go, unless you agree to join my experiment!

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
The kids in the orphanage were skinny and fragile.
No one was fed enough, nor did we have winter clothes ...
If only we had a "sister" like you to help us at that time.

Hobby.transcription:
They like to group people with talents ...
That's the reason why I became interested in the study of enchantment.
It doesn't matter whether the user is talented for Arcanum.

Praise.transcription:
You once told me that the Goldberg Machine is also an example of the Butterfly Effect.
I like this statement very much.

Intimacy.transcription: Ah, I seem to have grown a bit taller recently. Can you tell?

Chitchat I.transcription: There exists a "singular point" in everyone that makes him or her unique.

Chitchat II.transcription:
The dean always told me that I should laugh more as a child.
You look about the same age as me. Say cheese ...

Monologue.transcription:
Arcanists, ordinary people, rich and poor,
everyone's got blood, and may bleed.
Let us get along with everyone equally.

Deployment.transcription: Me? ... Did you find something?

Pre-Battle.transcription: What interesting accident will happen next?

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: Every choice will affect the outcome.

Select Ultimate.transcription: Just a reminder. Watch your steps.

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: Please live up to my expectations, colleagues.

Cast Arcane Skill II.transcription: Don't worry. Let's have a cup of tea.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Mind the machines on the ground ... Bang!

Battle Victory.transcription: I would like to express my deepest regret for the accidents.

Insight.transcription: A new accessory. I'm inspired! Thank you! You've been of great help!

Bottom of Insight.transcription: The day I've waited for has finally come. Welcome to my world.

First Encounter.transcription:
Hi! I am Sotheby. As you can see, I am an excellent and knowledgeable lady!
Huh, that farmer ... he actually owns a whole group of bicorns!

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
There are many arcane animals that only come out in the rain ...
Ah ... What has just flown away?!

To the Future.transcription:
Ms. Moissan told me the nutritional supplement formula I made couldn't be universal.
But it's fine. I believe in the future, everyone will use it!

Idle.transcription: Huh, is no one here now? Then I will read my diary out aloud!

Greetings.transcription: Welcome to Typhon's Movie Party!

Morning.transcription:
Good morning. Is Regulus here?
I heard she was hard up recently. I was wondering if I could help.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Everyone says "the early bird catches the worm."
But I have just been looking outside for a long time ...
And haven't found any birds or worms ...

Night.transcription:
Sounds like the roar of a wild beast, also like the spooky hoof of the underworld ...
I got it! It must be the Nightmare galloping away!
... Huh? The engine? What is that?

Bond: Night.transcription:
I just bought a rare and strong bicorn. I heard it only came out at night ...
A bull? Eh? Am I tricked?
And ... does bull have anything to do with beef?

Hat and Hair.transcription: Stop it! You can't just touch an adult's head!

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
The egg of the Wraith is one fingerbreadth, the beak of the Phoenix is three fingerbreadths,
while the tail of the Arcane Python measures the length of a whole finger ...

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
This is Typhon, the hero of Auto Island!
Fight against the evil Jupiter every day!

Hobby.transcription:
I'll have the most fun in a party!
Singing and dancing make me happy.
But my favorites are all about snacks, cakes and puddings!

Praise.transcription:
Ms. Moissan is my tutor. She taught me a lot of "common knowledge"!
Without her, there would be no outstanding and knowledgeable lady Sotheby!

Intimacy.transcription:
... You're here! My experiment is almost the last step.
Go find 500 grams of liquid gold and help me settle it!

Chitchat I.transcription: There are many Auto Islands on the Thames. Which will Typhon live on?

Chitchat II.transcription:
It must not feel well to be hungry, right?
Everyone says the nutritional supplement I made won't work. How can I adjust it?

Monologue.transcription:
The outside world is different from what I imagined.
There are more arcane animals than I thought ...
Humans are also more interesting!

Deployment.transcription: Bring the "Eastern Mandrakes" along? Naturally!

Pre-Battle.transcription: Are they here to play cat's cradle?

Select Incantation I.transcription: No potion comes without a dash of poison.

Select Incantation II.transcription: Perhaps a drop of Golden Elixir?

Select 3-star Incantation.transcription: I've never tried this one before.

Select Ultimate.transcription: May the red thread of fate be woven!

Cast Arcane Skill I.transcription: The Old Man under the Moon taught me this little trick in a dream!

Cast Ultimate.transcription: I can untie any knot!

Battle Victory.transcription:
Cat's cradle, cat's cradle, the soldier's bed!
Cat's cradle, cat's cradle, the fish's dish! ...
The Mandrakes taught me these.

Insight.transcription:
I saw the Old Man under the Moon last night, there beneath that tree!
I tried to get a better look at him, only to find it was just the Mandrakes tickling my palm.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: The outside world is much bigger ... than I thought ...

First Encounter.transcription:
Someone is just a knight, nameless, wandering, beholden to thee for taking me in.
If thou dost not mind, please let Someone serve thee till the end.

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
If it doesn't stop raining,
Someone will be the first knight to sacrifice his life because of the rusty armor.

To the Future.transcription:
Chivalry today is not common among young people.
In the future, will it be even worse? It really makes Someone worry.

Idle.transcription: Sometimes Someone looks away just like thee, but no one hath noticed it.

Greetings.transcription: Bonjour, comment allez-vous?

Morning.transcription:
Good morning.
Someone is practicing how to rotate the plate on the tip of the sword and keep balance.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
In the age when Someone lived, breakfast is not customary.
However, thy meal looks so delicious that Someone would like to have some grease for himself.

Night.transcription:
Are you worried about going bald if you stay up late?
Someone hath an ancient secret recipe from my Lord ...
Oh, please do not look at the portrait of his grandson.
Someone believes there is no necessary connection between the two.

Bond: Night.transcription:
Many years ago, on a starry night, an old friend drove to the moon ...
This may surprise thee, but even an elderly armor remembers things past once in a while.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
One step further, and you will be in close contact with Someone's nose ...
As long as you can hit Someone's head.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
What is the motivation for A Knight along the way? For justice. For honor. For faith ...
And for a bit of grease to prevent the armor from rusting.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Living without the body makes thee disappointed?
Then, please allow Someone to introduce thee to a trusty friend—Knight Dullahan.

Hobby.transcription:
Don't worry. All thy efforts will pay off.
Someone once learned the difficult technique of armor maintenance, and now it can be applied to himself.

Praise.transcription: Someone hath never doubted the reason for his loyalty to thee, and thou hast proved Someone's choice.

Intimacy.transcription:
Someone hath experienced the fight on the battlefield, as well as the brocade bed and the rose garden.
If you'd like some stories, Someone is always at thy service.

Chitchat I.transcription:
Even if the enemy is just an apple, A Knight will follow the code of fairness ...
So Someone only challenges one at a time.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Roland sætte luren på blodiga mundi, blæs han i med vreide;
Då rivna jord og jardir og ljod iver hav iver heier.

Monologue.transcription:
Someone's past will fade away with poems in the wind.
And now, Someone, with the sword,
will once again build a brand new legend for thee as a knight.

Deployment.transcription: An order is an order.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Please beat the drums.

Select Ultimate.transcription: Please warm the liquor for Someone.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: The drums and the horn sound. The sword shall be drawn.

Attacked I.transcription: Someone still hath the guts to fight.

Battle Victory.transcription: Ring the gong of victory.

Insight.transcription:
The dream is getting deeper ...
*sniffs* Mmm, the scales make Someone's nose tickle.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
The last time when honored, Someone was only a man too young.
But Someone's piety and oath hath been unchanged, now and always will be.

First Encounter.transcription:
The BSA number? I'm ... I am so sorry, I don't have a number ...
But I will make every effort to do my best. Trust me, please!

Suitcase Climate.transcription: It's cloudy again. What does Arlington look like now?

To the Future.transcription: In the future, I hope both boys and girls can join the scouts, freely.

Idle.transcription: I will make my plan even when the commander is not here.

Greetings.transcription: ... Hmm? You're here.

Morning.transcription: Good morning. Let me help you put the tent away, please.

Bond: Morning.transcription: Good morning. I will sketch the way you wake up now in my diary.

Night.transcription: Good evening. Please rest early. It's always right to have a regular schedule.

Bond: Night.transcription:
The stars ... They are so beautiful ... If I stay longer ...
No! No, we should all go to bed! Good night!

Hat and Hair.transcription: Am I wearing it right?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
If you want to get along with another Boy Scout,
extend your left hand and firmly grasp their left hand.
This is how we greet each other.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: ... I have my father's military badge in my necklace. It will lead my way.

Hobby.transcription:
All the soldiers were collecting badges, so was father, wasn't he?
When I collect enough badges, I will give him all of them.

Praise.transcription: Tough. Brave. Never give up. You've done a great job.

Intimacy.transcription: Please praise me ... Will you?

Chitchat I.transcription: Yes, I'm here. Do you need my help?

Chitchat II.transcription:
I like photos very much. It's the Arcane Skill that allows people to "never fade."
Let's take pictures together later.

Monologue.transcription:
It is you who convinced me ...
that even if I don't join the Boy Scouts,
I could stand on my own.

Deployment.transcription: Be prepared!

Pre-Battle.transcription: I will assist you to keep the battle under control.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Flaws! Take the offensive!

Battle Victory.transcription: Did I meet your expectations?

Insight.transcription: ... Is this a reward for me?

Bottom of Insight.transcription: Thank you for your appreciation, commander ... I will not stop making efforts.

First Encounter.transcription:
Good day! My name is Nick Bottom, the weaver in town.
I've also acted in dramas. Let me play the lion. Let me play the hero ...
Ahaha, yes, yes, now I will but make an ass!

Suitcase Climate.transcription: A foggy day ... Does it also come from her magic?

To the Future.transcription: All shall be well, haha, Jack shall have Jill.

Idle.transcription: Oh oh! It's alright. I am very good at entertaining myself.

Greetings.transcription: Heh heh, at your service.

Morning.transcription: Planer, saw, needle and thread. It's a new day!

Bond: Morning.transcription:
What a pity! No one would live in a dream forever.
I am willing to pay everything to come back the midsummer night.

Night.transcription: Birds have all returned. Only Bottom is still wandering, here and there.

Bond: Night.transcription:
What are these? I gathered the rosemary and parsley from the forest.
I wish there is a chance to send them tonight.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
I can make costumes.
Dukes and ladies, goats and birds, everyone needs masks! Do you need it too?

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
... What do you want?
A table, chair, clothes or a statue, I can make it with these hands and give it to you.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: If I become a complete ass, would that be better than now?

Hobby.transcription:
Yeah, yeah, I am very grateful for the drama.
I will play this role until ... until which day?

Praise.transcription: You are not frightened by my ass head. You are much better than my friends!

Intimacy.transcription:
Although I'm but a weaver,
as long as you want anything, I will try my best to find it.

Chitchat I.transcription:
In addition to my job, I'm also good at spinning around. Yes, donkey work.
I'm best at this kind of useless work, just like love.

Chitchat II.transcription: What's in a name? That which we call a rose by any other word would smell as sweet.

Monologue.transcription:
I don't know plays. I'm but a rugged craftsman ...
But who knows? No one. Each one of us is in the play.

Deployment.transcription: Cobweb, Peaseblossom, Mustardseed ... Good masters are all here.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Hail! Wonderful summer night!

Select Incantation II.transcription: Just as easy as dealing with wood and cloth.

Select Ultimate.transcription: It's a dream I shall never forget.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: One Two Three. Fall asleep with me.

Battle Victory.transcription: This is a perfect ending!

Insight.transcription:
Rounds after rounds, the wheat in the mill will be crushed in the round.
Days after days, she will come to me one day.

Bottom of Insight.transcription: My steps are more brisker!

Deployment.transcription: No wingman is needed.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Look at my back.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Swallow my exhaust!

Battle Victory.transcription: Hah ... Red-38 is about to return.

Insight.transcription: Limit? Still a long way off. Go ahead.

First Encounter.transcription:
As long as you watch my flight once, you will never forget my name.
I am Lilya. In other words, I am your Goddess of Victory.

Suitcase Climate.transcription: The wind ... It's most comfortable now. Let's take off!

To the Future.transcription:
I'm not sure what's going on now, but it would be nice to soar into the air.
We will need your help. Take us to the future, will you?

Idle.transcription:
Oh? Oh ...! Hey ... Здра́вствуй?
Can anyone hear my voice? Any man alive?

Greetings.transcription: Don't be in and out. You're bugging me.

Morning.transcription: Good morning, Mr. Golden Sun!

Bond: Morning.transcription:
Come and tell me what dreams you had yesterday.
No one cares about your dreams though.
I just want to listen to something for breakfast to shatter the boredom.

Night.transcription:
Go. Don't be annoying. I am going to take care of my lady Su-01ве now.
You want to help? What if you break it?

Bond: Night.transcription:
There's still a vacancy behind me on my broomstick. Would you like to ride together?
Of course, if you dare to vomit on my back, I won't spare you.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
You should be grateful that I am too lazy to move now.
Or you should know the first-class pilot's got a first-class head-butt, too.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription:
You must learn to control your wrist first to ride a broomstick ...
You know, there are many recruits who break their legs every year.

Clothing and Torso.transcription: Feel awesome? Now it's my turn to pet you.

Hobby.transcription:
If you haven't tried Kholodets with блин, you've never really lived.
Come here! I will show you the real Russian style.

Praise.transcription:
How can anyone not know how to appreciate Su-01ве!
Look at her elegant lines. Look at her wonderful propulsion system.
Listen to her operation. It is music from heaven.

Intimacy.transcription:
Hasn't the flight been approved yet? Forget it. Sit in your seat.
I will lift your body up, and make sure you look like flying in the air ...

Chitchat I.transcription: If all the rules of the flight manual shall be followed, I'd rather take the train.

Chitchat II.transcription:
Не слышны в саду даже шорохи
Всё здесь замерло до утра
Если б знали вы, как мне дороги
Подмосковные вечера.

Monologue.transcription:
I like the feeling of flying high at the highest speed.
I can split the air like a knife.
Nothing could catch me, they can only see my red shadow.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
Well done. Now I will bring countless victories as red flash.
You ... you made the right choice. I'll give you half of the medals.
Thank me for being generous.

First Encounter.transcription:
I am Druvis III. It's my pleasure to meet you.
... You said I didn't look very pleased?
Hah ... How about now?

Suitcase Climate.transcription:
Water travels from the ground to the sky, and then falls back;
just as I, who come from the forest, and now go back.

To the Future.transcription:
Perhaps when the dream of industrial society is realized,
no one will ever cut down the dense forest.
I am looking forward to that day.

Idle.transcription: ... Are you also listening to the wind dancing on the treetops?

Greetings.transcription: You brought me a gentle breeze on the field.

Morning.transcription:
When the sun rose, the beasts kept silence.
Then, I heard a bird flapping its wings. It's the first to leave the forest.

Bond: Morning.transcription:
If you are lazier and get up even later, you won't see such a beautiful sunrise.
... Does it matter?

Night.transcription: Tides of time rise and fall. Days and nights switch and whirl. The infinite loop will never come to an end.

Bond: Night.transcription:
The night falls. The beasts howl. The owls sob.
Their feet treading on the ground are just like the roots embedded into the soil.

Hat and Hair.transcription:
The green eyes are inherited from my mother.
Although I did not grow into a lady of the upper class as she wished ...
... I thank my mother for everything she left.

Sleeves and Hands.transcription: When I first saw trees and grass, I knew my life belonged to them.

Clothing and Torso.transcription:
Gowns and heels will not stop me.
I will jump into the woods, as I have done this countless times.

Hobby.transcription:
It is a pleasure to be alone in the forest.
In a flash, cards of days and nights are shuffled.

Praise.transcription: Your excellence proves my insight.

Intimacy.transcription:
I am not good at socializing with others, nor do I understand the truth behind ambiguity.
Is that a loss?

Chitchat I.transcription:
There is nothing new for trees and grass.
With no eyesight, nor hearing, they know it all. And I will lend an ear to their whispers.

Chitchat II.transcription: After I brew my Celtic ale, I hope everyone will appreciate it.

Monologue.transcription:
Revenge is only the self-comfort of those who are drowning in the past,
while I choose to look ahead.

Deployment.transcription: It's a good time.

Pre-Battle.transcription: Time for me to dance.

Cast Ultimate.transcription: Spinning round and round, knowing not when to stop.

Battle Victory.transcription: The song might fade, yet the melody remains.

Insight.transcription: See, the string vibrates with increasing fervor.

Bottom of Insight.transcription:
From now on, I will see and understand more.
You helped me, and I will give you an appropriate return.
